  /**
   * Register all effects on a given effect chain
   * @param {EffectChain} chain - The effect chain to register effects on
   * @param {string} busName - Name for logging (e.g., "Bus A", "Final")
   */
  function registerEffectsForChain(chain, busName) {
    const effectClasses = getEffectClasses();
    const ctx = getCtx();

    Object.keys(effectClasses).forEach(name => {
      const EffectClass = effectClasses[name];
      if (EffectClass) {
        try {
          const effect = new EffectClass(ctx);
          chain.registerEffect(name, effect);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Failed to create effect for', busName + ':', name, e);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the effect chain with all effects
   * Called after effect modules are loaded
   * Creates multi-bus architecture: 4 effect buses + final bus
   * Each instrument can route to any bus, all buses feed into final bus
   */
  function initEffectChain() {
    const ctx = getCtx();

    // Get default chain order
    const defaultOrder = SL.effectsUI ? SL.effectsUI.DEFAULT_CHAIN_ORDER :
      ['distortion', 'bitcrush', 'chorus', 'phaser', 'flanger', 'delay', 'reverb'];

    // Create multi-bus effect system
    if (SL.effects && SL.effects.EffectChain) {
      const busNames = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];

      // Create 4 effect buses
      // Register effects but DON'T put them in the chain order yet.
      // Empty order = direct pass-through (input → effectsOutput).
      // Effects join the chain only when explicitly enabled via UI.
      // This prevents disabled effects from breaking the audio graph.
      effectBuses = busNames.map((name, i) => {
        const bus = new SL.effects.EffectChain(ctx);
        registerEffectsForChain(bus, 'Bus ' + name);
        console.log('Created effect Bus', name, 'with', bus.getRegisteredEffects().length, 'effects (chain empty, pass-through)');
        return bus;
      });

      // Create final bus for master processing
      finalBus = new SL.effects.EffectChain(ctx);
      registerEffectsForChain(finalBus, 'Final');
      console.log('Created Final Bus with', finalBus.getRegisteredEffects().length, 'effects (chain empty, pass-through)');

      // Connect all effect buses to final bus input
      effectBuses.forEach((bus, i) => {
        bus.output.connect(finalBus.input);
        console.log('Connected Bus', busNames[i], '→ Final Bus');
      });

      // Create analyser for visualization
      analyserNode = ctx.createAnalyser();
      analyserNode.fftSize = 2048;
      analyserNode.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.8;

      // Connect final bus to analyser, then to destination
      finalBus.output.connect(analyserNode);
      analyserNode.connect(ctx.destination);

      // Set backwards-compatible effectChain to Bus A
      effectChain = effectBuses[0];

      console.log('Multi-bus effect system initialized: 4 buses + Final → analyser → destination');
    }

    // Create per-instrument master outputs and connect to default bus (A)
    const defaultBus = effectBuses.length > 0 ? effectBuses[0] : null;
    const destination = defaultBus ? defaultBus.input : ctx.destination;

    instruments.forEach((inst, i) => {
      inst.masterOutput = ctx.createGain();
      inst.masterOutput.gain.value = 1.0;
      inst.masterOutput.connect(destination);
      instrumentBusAssignment[i] = 0; // All instruments start on Bus A
      console.log('Created master output for instrument', i + 1, '→ Bus A');
    });

    // Set legacy masterOutput to current instrument's output
    masterOutput = instruments[currentInstrument].masterOutput;

    console.log('Multi-timbral routing initialized: 4 instruments → Bus A → Final → destination');

    // Initialize voice pool
    initVoicePool();

    // Initialize buffer pool (reduces GC during playback)
    initBufferPool();

    // Initialize wavetables (pre-compute band-limited waveforms)
    initWavetables();

    // Export effect chain for UI access
    SL.audio.effectChain = effectChain;

    // Initialize AudioWorklet (async, non-blocking)
    initSynthWorklet().catch(e => {
      console.warn('[AUDIO] AudioWorklet init failed (fallback to band-limited):', e.message || e);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Initialize the AudioWorklet for synthesis
   * Runs asynchronously and sets workletSupported when ready
   */
  async function initSynthWorklet() {
    // Check if AudioWorklet is supported
    if (!audioContext || !audioContext.audioWorklet) {
      console.log('AudioWorklet not supported in this browser');
      workletSupported = false;
      return;
    }

    // Prevent multiple initialization attempts
    if (workletInitializing || synthWorkletNode) {
      return workletReadyPromise;
    }

    workletInitializing = true;
    console.log('Initializing AudioWorklet...');

    workletReadyPromise = new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
      try {
        // Load the worklet module
        // Note: The path is relative to the HTML document
        var __wBlob = new Blob([window.__SSL_WORKLET_CODE], {type: 'application/javascript'});
        var __wUrl = URL.createObjectURL(__wBlob);
        await audioContext.audioWorklet.addModule(__wUrl);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(__wUrl);

        // Create the worklet node
        synthWorkletNode = new AudioWorkletNode(audioContext, 'synth-worklet', {
          numberOfInputs: 0,
          numberOfOutputs: 1,
          outputChannelCount: [1]
        });

        // Connect worklet to current instrument's master output (respects bus routing)
        const inst = instruments[currentInstrument];
        const destination = (inst && inst.masterOutput) ? inst.masterOutput :
          (effectChain ? effectChain.input : audioContext.destination);
        synthWorkletNode.connect(destination);

        // Handle messages from worklet
        synthWorkletNode.port.onmessage = (event) => {
          const data = event.data;
          if (data.type === 'ready') {
            console.log('AudioWorklet processor ready');
            workletSupported = true;
            workletInitializing = false;
            resolve(true);
          } else if (data.type === 'noteStarted') {
            // Optional: track voice allocation
          }
        };

        // Handle errors
        synthWorkletNode.onprocessorerror = (event) => {
          console.error('AudioWorklet processor error:', event);
          workletSupported = false;
          workletInitializing = false;
          reject(event);
        };

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to initialize AudioWorklet:', error);
        workletSupported = false;
        workletInitializing = false;
        reject(error);
      }
    });

    return workletReadyPromise;
  }

  /**
   * Check if worklet synthesis is available
   * @returns {boolean} Whether worklet can be used
   */
  function isWorkletAvailable() {
    return workletSupported && synthWorkletNode !== null;
  }

  /**
   * Send a note on message to the worklet
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   * @param {number} dur - Duration in seconds
   * @param {Object} oscSettings - Oscillator settings array
   * @param {Object} adsr - ADSR envelope settings
   * @param {number} refHz - A4 reference frequency
   */
  function workletNoteOn(midi, dur, oscSettings, adsr, refHz) {
    if (!synthWorkletNode) return;

    synthWorkletNode.port.postMessage({
      type: 'noteOn',
      midi: midi,
      velocity: 127,
      duration: dur,
      oscillators: oscSettings,
      adsr: adsr,
      refHz: refHz || 440
    });

    // Schedule note off after duration
    setTimeout(() => {
      workletNoteOff(midi);
    }, dur * 1000);
  }

  /**
   * Send a note off message to the worklet
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   */
  function workletNoteOff(midi) {
    if (!synthWorkletNode) return;

    synthWorkletNode.port.postMessage({
      type: 'noteOff',
      midi: midi
    });
  }

  /**
   * Send all notes off to the worklet
   */
  function workletAllNotesOff() {
    if (!synthWorkletNode) return;

    synthWorkletNode.port.postMessage({
      type: 'allNotesOff'
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Frequency & Harmonics Calculations
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Convert MIDI note number to frequency
   * Uses A4 reference from UI input
   * @param {number} n - MIDI note number (0-127)
   * @returns {number} Frequency in Hz
   */
  function m2f(n) {
    const a4 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('refHz').value) || 440;
    return a4 * Math.pow(2, (n - 69) / 12);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate maximum harmonics for band-limited synthesis
   * Prevents aliasing by limiting harmonics to Nyquist frequency
   * @param {number} f - Fundamental frequency in Hz
   * @returns {number} Maximum number of harmonics
   */
  function maxH(f) {
    const sr = SL.SR || 44100;
    return Math.floor((sr / 2) / f);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // PolyBLEP Anti-Aliasing
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * PolyBLEP (Polynomial Band-Limited Step) correction
   * Reduces aliasing at discontinuities with minimal CPU cost
   * @param {number} t - Phase position [0, 1)
   * @param {number} dt - Phase increment (freq / sampleRate)
   * @returns {number} Correction value to apply at discontinuity
   */
  function polyBlep(t, dt) {
    if (t < dt) {
      t /= dt;
      return t + t - t * t - 1;
    } else if (t > 1 - dt) {
      t = (t - 1) / dt;
      return t * t + t + t + 1;
    }
    return 0;
  }

  /**
   * Generate PolyBLEP-corrected sawtooth sample
   * @param {number} phase - Phase position [0, 1)
   * @param {number} dt - Phase increment (freq / sampleRate)
   * @returns {number} Anti-aliased sawtooth sample [-1, 1]
   */
  function polyBlepSaw(phase, dt) {
    // Naive sawtooth: rises from -1 to 1, then wraps
    let sample = 2 * phase - 1;
    // Apply PolyBLEP correction at the wrap point (phase = 0/1)
    sample -= polyBlep(phase, dt);
    return sample;
  }

  /**
   * Generate PolyBLEP-corrected square wave sample
   * @param {number} phase - Phase position [0, 1)
   * @param {number} dt - Phase increment (freq / sampleRate)
   * @returns {number} Anti-aliased square sample [-1, 1]
   */
  function polyBlepSquare(phase, dt) {
    // Naive square wave
    let sample = phase < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
    // Apply PolyBLEP at both discontinuities (0 and 0.5)
    sample += polyBlep(phase, dt);
    sample -= polyBlep((phase + 0.5) % 1, dt);
    return sample;
  }

  /**
   * Generate PolyBLEP-corrected pulse wave sample
   * @param {number} phase - Phase position [0, 1)
   * @param {number} dt - Phase increment (freq / sampleRate)
   * @param {number} pw - Pulse width [0, 1]
   * @returns {number} Anti-aliased pulse sample [-1, 1]
   */
  function polyBlepPulse(phase, dt, pw) {
    // Naive pulse wave
    let sample = phase < pw ? 1 : -1;
    // Apply PolyBLEP at both discontinuities (0 and pw)
    sample += polyBlep(phase, dt);
    sample -= polyBlep((phase + (1 - pw)) % 1, dt);
    return sample;
  }

  /**
   * Generate PolyBLEP-corrected triangle wave sample
   * Derived from integrated square wave for better anti-aliasing
   * @param {number} phase - Phase position [0, 1)
   * @param {number} dt - Phase increment (freq / sampleRate)
   * @returns {number} Anti-aliased triangle sample [-1, 1]
   */
  function polyBlepTriangle(phase, dt) {
    // Use differentiated parabolic wave for better results
    // This gives a cleaner triangle with PolyBLEP characteristics
    let sample = phase < 0.5 ? 4 * phase - 1 : 3 - 4 * phase;
    return sample;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Pulse Wave (PWM) Generation
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create a PeriodicWave for a pulse wave with specified duty cycle
   * Uses Fourier series: pulse wave harmonics = (2 / (h * PI)) * sin(h * PI * pw)
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {number} pulseWidth - Pulse width as percentage (5-95)
   * @param {number} numHarmonics - Number of harmonics to include
   * @returns {PeriodicWave}
   */
  function createPulseWave(ctx, pulseWidth, numHarmonics) {
    numHarmonics = numHarmonics || 64;
    const pw = pulseWidth / 100; // Convert to 0-1 range

    // Fourier coefficients for pulse wave
    const real = new Float32Array(numHarmonics + 1);
    const imag = new Float32Array(numHarmonics + 1);

    real[0] = 0; // DC offset
    imag[0] = 0;

    for (let h = 1; h <= numHarmonics; h++) {
      // Pulse wave Fourier series: (2 / (h * PI)) * sin(h * PI * pw)
      // The imaginary component gives us the sine harmonics
      real[h] = 0;
      imag[h] = (2 / (h * Math.PI)) * Math.sin(h * Math.PI * pw);
    }

    return ctx.createPeriodicWave(real, imag, { disableNormalization: false });
  }

  // Super saw detune offsets in cents (7 voices)
  const SUPERSAW_DETUNES = [-40, -25, -10, 0, 10, 25, 40];

  /**
   * Create multiple detuned sawtooth oscillators for super saw effect
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {number} freq - Base frequency
   * @param {number} spread - Spread amount (0-100)
   * @param {GainNode} outputNode - Node to connect oscillators to
   * @param {number} level - Overall level (0-1)
   * @returns {OscillatorNode[]} Array of oscillator nodes
   */
  function createSuperSawOscillators(ctx, freq, spread, outputNode, level) {
    const oscillators = [];
    const spreadFactor = spread / 50; // Normalize: 50% = full detune, 0% = no detune
    const voiceGain = level / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length; // Split level among voices

    SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();

      // Apply spread to detune
      const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
      const voiceFreq = freq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);

      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.value = voiceFreq;
      gain.gain.value = voiceGain;

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(outputNode);

      oscillators.push(osc);
    });

    return oscillators;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Parameter Getters
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Convert linear slider value to logarithmic time value (for ADSR)
   * Gives finer control at lower values where it matters most musically
   * @param {number} sliderValue - Linear slider position (0 to max)
   * @param {number} sliderMax - Maximum slider value
   * @param {number} timeMax - Maximum output time in ms
   * @returns {number} Time in milliseconds
   */
  function sliderToTime(sliderValue, sliderMax, timeMax) {
    // Use power curve: more resolution at low values
    // slider^2 gives good feel for envelope times
    const normalized = sliderValue / sliderMax;
    return timeMax * Math.pow(normalized, 2);
  }

  /**
   * Convert logarithmic time value back to linear slider value
   * @param {number} timeMs - Time in milliseconds
   * @param {number} sliderMax - Maximum slider value
   * @param {number} timeMax - Maximum time in ms
   * @returns {number} Slider value
   */
  function timeToSlider(timeMs, sliderMax, timeMax) {
    const normalized = Math.sqrt(timeMs / timeMax);
    return normalized * sliderMax;
  }

  /**
   * Get ADSR envelope values from UI sliders
   * Uses logarithmic scaling for time parameters (A, D, R)
   * Converts milliseconds to seconds for Web Audio
   * @returns {{a: number, d: number, s: number, r: number}} ADSR values in seconds (sustain is 0-1)
   */
  function getADSR() {
    // Slider ranges: A=0-500, D=0-500, S=0-100, R=0-1000
    // Max times: A=500ms, D=500ms, R=1000ms
    const aSlider = parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrA').value) || 10;
    const dSlider = parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrD').value) || 100;
    const sSlider = parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrS').value) || 70;
    const rSlider = parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrR').value) || 200;

    return {
      a: sliderToTime(aSlider, 500, 500) / 1000,  // Convert to seconds
      d: sliderToTime(dSlider, 500, 500) / 1000,
      s: sSlider / 100,  // Sustain stays linear (0-1)
      r: sliderToTime(rSlider, 1000, 1000) / 1000
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get oscillator mixer settings from UI controls
   * Reads from inline controls (which are synced from modal when modal changes)
   * @returns {Array<{wave: string, oct: number, detune: number, level: number}>}
   */
  function getOscSettings() {
    const results = [];

    for (let n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
      // Read from inline controls (modal syncs to inline on every change)
      const inlineWave = document.querySelector('.osc-wave[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineOct = document.querySelector('.osc-oct[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineDetune = document.querySelector('.osc-detune[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineLevel = document.querySelector('.osc-level[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      // Read pulse width and spread from modal controls
      const modalPw = document.querySelector('.osc-pw-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const modalSpread = document.querySelector('.osc-spread-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');

      const wave = inlineWave ? inlineWave.value : 'sawtooth';
      const oct = inlineOct ? parseInt(inlineOct.value) || 0 : 0;
      const detune = inlineDetune ? parseFloat(inlineDetune.value) || 0 : 0;
      const level = inlineLevel ? parseFloat(inlineLevel.value) / 100 : 0.5;
      // Pulse width: 5-95%, default 50%
      const pulseWidth = modalPw ? parseFloat(modalPw.value) : 50;
      // Super saw spread: 0-100%, default 50%
      const superSawSpread = modalSpread ? parseFloat(modalSpread.value) : 50;

      console.log('OSC ' + n + ' settings:', {
        wave, oct, detune, level, pulseWidth, superSawSpread,
        elements: {
          wave: !!inlineWave,
          oct: !!inlineOct,
          detune: !!inlineDetune,
          level: !!inlineLevel
        }
      });

      results.push({ wave, oct, detune, level, pulseWidth, superSawSpread });
    }

    return results;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Filter Settings & Creation
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Convert slider value (0-1000) to frequency (20-20000Hz) using logarithmic scale
   * This gives equal perceptual spacing across the frequency range
   * @param {number} sliderValue - Slider position (0-1000)
   * @returns {number} Frequency in Hz
   */
  function sliderToFreq(sliderValue) {
    const minFreq = 20;
    const maxFreq = 20000;
    const minLog = Math.log10(minFreq);
    const maxLog = Math.log10(maxFreq);
    const logValue = minLog + (sliderValue / 1000) * (maxLog - minLog);
    return Math.pow(10, logValue);
  }

  /**
   * Convert frequency (20-20000Hz) to slider value (0-1000) using logarithmic scale
   * @param {number} freq - Frequency in Hz
   * @returns {number} Slider position (0-1000)
   */
  function freqToSlider(freq) {
    const minFreq = 20;
    const maxFreq = 20000;
    const clampedFreq = Math.max(minFreq, Math.min(maxFreq, freq));
    const minLog = Math.log10(minFreq);
    const maxLog = Math.log10(maxFreq);
    const logFreq = Math.log10(clampedFreq);
    return ((logFreq - minLog) / (maxLog - minLog)) * 1000;
  }

  /**
   * Convert slider value (0-100) to Q factor (0.5-20)
   * Uses a slight exponential curve to make lower Q values more accessible
   * Typical synth resonance ranges: Moog 0-4, MS-20 0-10+, modern synths 0.5-20
   * @param {number} sliderValue - Slider position (0-100)
   * @returns {number} Q factor
   */
  function sliderToQ(sliderValue) {
    const minQ = 0.5;
    const maxQ = 20;
    // Slight exponential curve: lower values are more spread out
    const normalized = sliderValue / 100;
    const curved = Math.pow(normalized, 1.5);
    return minQ + curved * (maxQ - minQ);
  }

  /**
   * Convert Q factor (0.5-20) to slider value (0-100)
   * @param {number} q - Q factor
   * @returns {number} Slider position (0-100)
   */
  function qToSlider(q) {
    const minQ = 0.5;
    const maxQ = 20;
    const clampedQ = Math.max(minQ, Math.min(maxQ, q));
    const normalized = (clampedQ - minQ) / (maxQ - minQ);
    return Math.pow(normalized, 1 / 1.5) * 100;
  }

  /**
   * Get filter settings from UI controls
   * Reads from inline controls (which are synced from modal)
   * Converts slider values to actual frequency/Q using logarithmic scaling
   * @returns {{enabled: boolean, type: string, slope: number, frequency: number, resonance: number, keyTrack: number, model: string}}
   */
  function getFilterSettings() {
    const enabled = document.getElementById('filterEnabled');
    const typeSelect = document.getElementById('filterType');
    const slopeRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="filterSlope"]:checked');
    const freqSlider = document.getElementById('filterFreq');
    const qSlider = document.getElementById('filterQ');
    const keyTrackSlider = document.getElementById('filterKeyTrack');
    const model = document.getElementById('filterModel');

    // Convert slider values to actual frequency/Q
    const freqSliderValue = freqSlider ? parseFloat(freqSlider.value) : 850;
    const qSliderValue = qSlider ? parseFloat(qSlider.value) : 10;
    const keyTrackValue = keyTrackSlider ? parseFloat(keyTrackSlider.value) / 100 : 0;

    return {
      enabled: enabled ? enabled.checked : true,
      type: typeSelect ? typeSelect.value : 'lowpass',
      slope: slopeRadio ? parseInt(slopeRadio.value) : 24,
      frequency: sliderToFreq(freqSliderValue),
      resonance: sliderToQ(qSliderValue),
      keyTrack: keyTrackValue, // 0-2 (0% to 200%)
      model: model ? model.value : 'butterworth'
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get noise settings from UI controls
   * Noise is always enabled now (no enable checkbox) - level controls whether it's audible
   * @returns {{enabled: boolean, type: string, level: number}}
   */
  function getNoiseSettings() {
    const typeSelect = document.getElementById('noiseType');
    const levelSlider = document.getElementById('noiseLevel');
    const level = levelSlider ? parseFloat(levelSlider.value) / 100 : 0;

    // Noise is always "enabled" but only audible if level > 0
    return {
      enabled: level > 0, // Only create noise if level is above 0
      type: typeSelect ? typeSelect.value : 'white',
      level: level
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get filter envelope settings from UI controls
   * Uses logarithmic scaling for time parameters (A, D, R)
   * @returns {{enabled: boolean, amount: number, attack: number, decay: number, sustain: number, release: number, linkToAmp: boolean}}
   */
  function getFilterEnvSettings() {
    const enabled = document.getElementById('filterEnvEnabled');
    const amount = document.getElementById('filterEnvAmount');
    const attack = document.getElementById('filterEnvA');
    const decay = document.getElementById('filterEnvD');
    const sustain = document.getElementById('filterEnvS');
    const release = document.getElementById('filterEnvR');
    const linkToAmp = document.getElementById('filterEnvLinkToAmp');

    // If linked to amp envelope, use amplitude ADSR values (already logarithmic)
    if (linkToAmp && linkToAmp.checked) {
      const ampAdsr = getADSR();
      return {
        enabled: enabled ? enabled.checked : false,
        amount: amount ? parseFloat(amount.value) : 24,
        attack: ampAdsr.a * 1000,    // Convert seconds to ms
        decay: ampAdsr.d * 1000,
        sustain: ampAdsr.s * 100,    // Convert 0-1 to percent
        release: ampAdsr.r * 1000,
        linkToAmp: true
      };
    }

    // Slider ranges: A=0-2000, D=0-2000, S=0-100, R=0-3000
    // Apply logarithmic scaling to time values
    const aSlider = attack ? parseFloat(attack.value) : 10;
    const dSlider = decay ? parseFloat(decay.value) : 150;
    const sSlider = sustain ? parseFloat(sustain.value) : 0;
    const rSlider = release ? parseFloat(release.value) : 200;

    return {
      enabled: enabled ? enabled.checked : false,
      amount: amount ? parseFloat(amount.value) : 24,
      attack: sliderToTime(aSlider, 2000, 2000),   // 0-2000ms with log scale
      decay: sliderToTime(dSlider, 2000, 2000),    // 0-2000ms with log scale
      sustain: sSlider,                              // 0-100% linear
      release: sliderToTime(rSlider, 3000, 3000),  // 0-3000ms with log scale
      linkToAmp: false
    };
  }

  /**
   * Calculate key-tracked filter cutoff frequency
   * @param {number} baseFreq - Base cutoff frequency from settings
   * @param {number} noteFreq - Frequency of the note being played
   * @param {number} keyTrack - Key tracking amount (0-2 for 0-200%)
   * @returns {number} Adjusted cutoff frequency
   */
  function calcKeyTrackedFreq(baseFreq, noteFreq, keyTrack) {
    console.log('calcKeyTrackedFreq: baseFreq=' + baseFreq + ', noteFreq=' + noteFreq + ', keyTrack=' + keyTrack);

    if (keyTrack === 0) {
      console.log('calcKeyTrackedFreq: keyTrack is 0, returning baseFreq');
      return baseFreq;
    }

    // Reference frequency is middle C (C4 = 261.63 Hz)
    const refFreq = 261.63;

    // Calculate how many octaves above/below reference
    const octaveDiff = Math.log2(noteFreq / refFreq);
    console.log('calcKeyTrackedFreq: octaveDiff=' + octaveDiff);

    // Apply key tracking: each octave shifts cutoff by keyTrack amount
    // At 100% key track (1.0), cutoff doubles per octave (follows pitch)
    // At 200% key track (2.0), cutoff quadruples per octave
    const multiplier = Math.pow(2, octaveDiff * keyTrack);
    console.log('calcKeyTrackedFreq: multiplier=' + multiplier);

    // Clamp to reasonable range
    const result = Math.max(20, Math.min(20000, baseFreq * multiplier));
    console.log('calcKeyTrackedFreq: result=' + result);
    return result;
  }

  // Noise buffer cache (reused for performance)
  let whiteNoiseBuffer = null;
  let pinkNoiseBuffer = null;
  let brownNoiseBuffer = null;

  /**
   * Create a noise buffer of the specified type
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {string} type - 'white', 'pink', or 'brown'
   * @returns {AudioBuffer}
   */
  function createNoiseBuffer(ctx, type) {
    const bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * 2; // 2 seconds of noise
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    if (type === 'white') {
      // White noise: random values
      for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      }
    } else if (type === 'pink') {
      // Pink noise: -3dB/octave rolloff using Paul Kellet's algorithm
      let b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, b3 = 0, b4 = 0, b5 = 0, b6 = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        b0 = 0.99886 * b0 + white * 0.0555179;
        b1 = 0.99332 * b1 + white * 0.0750759;
        b2 = 0.96900 * b2 + white * 0.1538520;
        b3 = 0.86650 * b3 + white * 0.3104856;
        b4 = 0.55000 * b4 + white * 0.5329522;
        b5 = -0.7616 * b5 - white * 0.0168980;
        data[i] = (b0 + b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 + b5 + b6 + white * 0.5362) * 0.11;
        b6 = white * 0.115926;
      }
    } else if (type === 'brown') {
      // Brown (red) noise: -6dB/octave rolloff (integrated white noise)
      let lastOut = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        lastOut = (lastOut + (0.02 * white)) / 1.02;
        data[i] = lastOut * 3.5; // Normalize
      }
    }

    return buffer;
  }

  /**
   * Get or create a noise buffer of the specified type (cached)
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {string} type - 'white', 'pink', or 'brown'
   * @returns {AudioBuffer}
   */
  function getNoiseBuffer(ctx, type) {
    if (type === 'white') {
      if (!whiteNoiseBuffer) whiteNoiseBuffer = createNoiseBuffer(ctx, 'white');
      return whiteNoiseBuffer;
    } else if (type === 'pink') {
      if (!pinkNoiseBuffer) pinkNoiseBuffer = createNoiseBuffer(ctx, 'pink');
      return pinkNoiseBuffer;
    } else {
      if (!brownNoiseBuffer) brownNoiseBuffer = createNoiseBuffer(ctx, 'brown');
      return brownNoiseBuffer;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Create a noise source node
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Noise settings from getNoiseSettings()
   * @returns {{source: AudioBufferSourceNode, gain: GainNode}|null}
   */
  function createNoiseSource(ctx, settings) {
    if (!settings.enabled) return null;

    const buffer = getNoiseBuffer(ctx, settings.type);
    const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer = buffer;
    source.loop = true;

    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    gain.gain.value = settings.level * 0.5; // Scale down noise level

    source.connect(gain);

    return { source, gain };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Filter Model Implementations
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Create a standard Butterworth filter chain (original implementation)
   * Clean, neutral response - the "vanilla" option
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Filter settings
   * @returns {{input: BiquadFilterNode, output: BiquadFilterNode, filters: BiquadFilterNode[]}}
   */
  function createButterworthFilter(ctx, settings) {
    const filter1 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter1.type = settings.type;
    filter1.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    filter1.Q.value = settings.resonance;

    if (settings.slope === 12) {
      return { input: filter1, output: filter1, filters: [filter1] };
    }

    // 24dB/oct: chain two biquads
    const filter2 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter2.type = settings.type;
    filter2.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    // Reduce Q on second stage to prevent excessive resonance
    filter2.Q.value = Math.max(0.1, settings.resonance * 0.707);
    filter1.connect(filter2);

    return { input: filter1, output: filter2, filters: [filter1, filter2] };
  }

  /**
   * Create a Moog-style ladder filter approximation
   * Characteristics: Warm, fat sound with resonance that "sings"
   * Uses 4 cascaded lowpass stages (24dB) with modified Q distribution
   * The Moog ladder has a distinctive resonance peak that adds harmonics
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Filter settings
   * @returns {{input: AudioNode, output: AudioNode, filters: BiquadFilterNode[]}}
   */
  function createMoogFilter(ctx, settings) {
    const filters = [];
    const numStages = settings.slope === 12 ? 2 : 4;

    // Moog ladder uses progressively increasing Q through stages
    // This creates the characteristic "fat" resonance
    // Each stage is a 6dB lowpass, 4 stages = 24dB
    const baseQ = 0.5;
    // Resonance affects the feedback character - higher Q = more emphasis at cutoff
    const resonanceFactor = Math.pow(settings.resonance / 10, 0.7);

    for (let i = 0; i < numStages; i++) {
      const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      filter.type = 'lowpass'; // Moog ladder is always lowpass internally
      filter.frequency.value = settings.frequency;

      // Q distribution: later stages get more resonance (emulates feedback)
      // This creates the characteristic "singing" resonance
      const stageQ = baseQ + (resonanceFactor * (i + 1) / numStages) * 8;
      filter.Q.value = Math.min(stageQ, 20); // Cap to prevent instability

      filters.push(filter);
    }

    // Chain the filters
    for (let i = 0; i < filters.length - 1; i++) {
      filters[i].connect(filters[i + 1]);
    }

    // For highpass/bandpass types, add a final stage with the requested type
    // The Moog character comes from the cascaded lowpass, then shaped
    let output = filters[filters.length - 1];
    if (settings.type !== 'lowpass') {
      const shaper = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      shaper.type = settings.type;
      shaper.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
      shaper.Q.value = settings.resonance;
      output.connect(shaper);
      filters.push(shaper);
      output = shaper;
    }

    return { input: filters[0], output: output, filters: filters };
  }

  /**
   * Create a State Variable Filter (SVF) approximation
   * Characteristics: Clean, precise, with smooth resonance sweep
   * The SVF provides simultaneous LP/HP/BP from the same structure
   * We use parallel filters mixed to achieve the characteristic response
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Filter settings
   * @returns {{input: AudioNode, output: AudioNode, filters: BiquadFilterNode[]}}
   */
  function createSVFFilter(ctx, settings) {
    const filters = [];

    // SVF has a different resonance curve - more linear sweep
    // We approximate this with specific Q scaling
    // SVF resonance is typically 0-1 range where 1 = self-oscillation
    const svfQ = 0.5 + (settings.resonance * 2.5);

    if (settings.slope === 12) {
      // Single SVF stage
      const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      filter.type = settings.type;
      filter.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
      filter.Q.value = svfQ;
      filters.push(filter);

      return { input: filter, output: filter, filters: filters };
    }

    // For 24dB: Two SVF stages in series
    // SVF stacking maintains cleaner transients than ladder
    const filter1 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter1.type = settings.type;
    filter1.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    filter1.Q.value = svfQ;
    filters.push(filter1);

    const filter2 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter2.type = settings.type;
    filter2.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    // Second stage with slightly lower Q for smoother response
    filter2.Q.value = svfQ * 0.8;
    filters.push(filter2);

    filter1.connect(filter2);

    return { input: filter1, output: filter2, filters: filters };
  }

  /**
   * Create an MS-20 style aggressive filter approximation
   * Characteristics: Raw, aggressive, can self-oscillate, gritty resonance
   * The MS-20 filter has an aggressive, almost distorted quality at high resonance
   * Uses a Sallen-Key inspired topology with extreme Q capabilities
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Filter settings
   * @returns {{input: AudioNode, output: AudioNode, filters: AudioNode[]}}
   */
  function createMS20Filter(ctx, settings) {
    const filters = [];

    // MS-20 has a very aggressive resonance curve
    // It can self-oscillate and has a "screaming" quality
    // We use exponential Q scaling to approximate this behavior
    const aggressiveQ = 0.5 + Math.pow(settings.resonance / 5, 1.8) * 25;

    // MS-20 also has some inherent "dirt" - we add a subtle waveshaper
    const inputGain = ctx.createGain();
    inputGain.gain.value = 1.0 + (settings.resonance / 30); // Slight input boost with resonance

    const filter1 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter1.type = settings.type;
    filter1.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    filter1.Q.value = Math.min(aggressiveQ, 30); // MS-20 can get VERY resonant
    filters.push(filter1);

    inputGain.connect(filter1);

    if (settings.slope === 12) {
      return { input: inputGain, output: filter1, filters: [inputGain, filter1] };
    }

    // 24dB: Second stage with even more aggressive Q
    const filter2 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter2.type = settings.type;
    filter2.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    // Second stage gets even more resonant for that screaming quality
    filter2.Q.value = Math.min(aggressiveQ * 1.2, 35);
    filters.push(filter2);

    filter1.connect(filter2);

    // Add subtle soft-clipping for the MS-20 "grit"
    // Using a waveshaper with gentle saturation curve
    const waveshaper = ctx.createWaveShaper();
    waveshaper.curve = createMS20SaturationCurve(settings.resonance);
    waveshaper.oversample = '2x';
    filter2.connect(waveshaper);
    filters.push(waveshaper);

    return { input: inputGain, output: waveshaper, filters: [inputGain, filter1, filter2, waveshaper] };
  }

  /**
   * Create a soft saturation curve for MS-20 style grit
   * More resonance = more saturation
   * @param {number} resonance - Resonance value (0-30 typical)
   * @returns {Float32Array} Waveshaper curve
   */
  function createMS20SaturationCurve(resonance) {
    const samples = 256;
    const curve = new Float32Array(samples);
    const amount = 0.1 + (resonance / 30) * 0.4; // 10-50% saturation based on resonance

    for (let i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
      const x = (i / (samples - 1)) * 2 - 1; // -1 to 1
      // Soft clipping using tanh-like curve
      curve[i] = Math.tanh(x * (1 + amount * 2)) / Math.tanh(1 + amount * 2);
    }
    return curve;
  }

  /**
   * Create an Oberheim SEM style filter approximation
   * Characteristics: Smooth, musical, slightly "hollow" quality
   * The SEM filter is known for its smooth resonance and musical character
   * It has a 12dB/oct slope that many find more musical than 24dB
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Filter settings
   * @returns {{input: AudioNode, output: AudioNode, filters: BiquadFilterNode[]}}
   */
  function createOberheimFilter(ctx, settings) {
    const filters = [];

    // Oberheim SEM has a smooth, musical Q curve
    // The resonance adds emphasis without getting harsh
    // It's known for a slightly "hollow" or "nasal" quality
    const semQ = 0.7 + Math.sqrt(settings.resonance) * 2.5;

    // The SEM uses a state-variable topology but with specific frequency offsetting
    // We approximate this by using slightly detuned parallel paths

    const filter1 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter1.type = settings.type;
    filter1.frequency.value = settings.frequency;
    filter1.Q.value = semQ;
    filters.push(filter1);

    if (settings.slope === 12) {
      // SEM is naturally 12dB - this is its sweet spot
      return { input: filter1, output: filter1, filters: filters };
    }

    // For 24dB: Add a second stage with frequency offset for "notch" character
    // This creates the distinctive Oberheim hollow sound
    const filter2 = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    filter2.type = settings.type;
    // Slight frequency offset creates the SEM's characteristic phase response
    filter2.frequency.value = settings.frequency * 0.97;
    filter2.Q.value = semQ * 0.9;
    filters.push(filter2);

    filter1.connect(filter2);

    return { input: filter1, output: filter2, filters: filters };
  }

  /**
   * Create a filter chain based on settings
   * Supports multiple filter models: butterworth, moog, svf, ms20, oberheim
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   * @param {Object} settings - Filter settings from getFilterSettings()
   * @returns {{input: AudioNode, output: AudioNode, filters: AudioNode[]}|null}
   */
  function createFilterChain(ctx, settings) {
    if (!settings.enabled) return null;

    const model = settings.model || 'butterworth';

    switch (model) {
      case 'moog':
        return createMoogFilter(ctx, settings);
      case 'svf':
        return createSVFFilter(ctx, settings);
      case 'ms20':
        return createMS20Filter(ctx, settings);
      case 'oberheim':
        return createOberheimFilter(ctx, settings);
      case 'butterworth':
      default:
        return createButterworthFilter(ctx, settings);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Convert frequency to note name
   * @param {number} freq - Frequency in Hz
   * @returns {string} Note name with octave (e.g., "A4", "C#5")
   */
  function freqToNote(freq) {
    const A4 = 440;
    const semitones = 12 * Math.log2(freq / A4);
    const midiNote = Math.round(69 + semitones);
    const octave = Math.floor(midiNote / 12) - 1;
    const noteIndex = ((midiNote % 12) + 12) % 12;
    return SL.NOTE_NAMES[noteIndex] + octave;
  }

  /**
   * Convert note name to frequency
   * @param {string} noteName - Note name with octave (e.g., "A4", "C#5")
   * @returns {number} Frequency in Hz
   */
  function noteToFreq(noteName) {
    const match = noteName.match(/^([A-G]#?)(\d+)$/);
    if (!match) return 440;
    const note = match[1];
    const octave = parseInt(match[2]);
    const noteIndex = SL.NOTE_NAMES.indexOf(note);
    if (noteIndex === -1) return 440;
    const midiNote = (octave + 1) * 12 + noteIndex;
    return 440 * Math.pow(2, (midiNote - 69) / 12);
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Filter Envelope Functions
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Apply filter envelope to a filter chain (attack/decay/sustain phases)
   * Called when a note starts - schedules frequency automation
   * @param {Object} filterChain - Filter chain from createFilterChain()
   * @param {number} noteFreq - Frequency of the note being played (for key tracking)
   * @param {Object} filterSettings - Filter settings from getFilterSettings()
   * @param {Object} filterEnvSettings - Filter envelope settings from getFilterEnvSettings()
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   */
  function applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, noteFreq, filterSettings, filterEnvSettings, ctx) {
    console.log('applyFilterEnvelope called:', {
      enabled: filterEnvSettings.enabled,
      hasFilterChain: !!filterChain,
      hasFilters: filterChain ? !!filterChain.filters : false,
      numFilters: filterChain && filterChain.filters ? filterChain.filters.length : 0
    });

    if (!filterEnvSettings.enabled || !filterChain || !filterChain.filters) {
      console.log('applyFilterEnvelope: skipping - enabled=' + filterEnvSettings.enabled);
      return;
    }

    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    const baseFreq = filterSettings.frequency;

    // Calculate peak frequency based on amount in semitones
    // Positive amount = sweep UP from base, negative = sweep DOWN
    const peakFreq = Math.max(20, Math.min(20000, baseFreq * Math.pow(2, filterEnvSettings.amount / 12)));

    // Calculate sustain frequency (sustain% of the way from base to peak)
    const sustainFreq = baseFreq + (peakFreq - baseFreq) * (filterEnvSettings.sustain / 100);

    // Convert ms to seconds (already converted by getFilterEnvSettings if using log scale)
    const a = filterEnvSettings.attack / 1000;
    const d = filterEnvSettings.decay / 1000;

    console.log('FILTER ENV: base=' + baseFreq.toFixed(0) + 'Hz → peak=' + peakFreq.toFixed(0) + 'Hz → sustain=' + sustainFreq.toFixed(0) + 'Hz');
    console.log('FILTER ENV: Attack=' + (a * 1000).toFixed(1) + 'ms, Decay=' + (d * 1000).toFixed(1) + 'ms, Amount=' + filterEnvSettings.amount + ' st');

    // Apply envelope to all BiquadFilterNodes in the chain
    let appliedCount = 0;
    filterChain.filters.forEach((filter, idx) => {
      if (filter instanceof BiquadFilterNode) {
        const currentFreq = filter.frequency.value;

        // Cancel any existing automation to start fresh
        filter.frequency.cancelScheduledValues(now);

        // Start from base frequency (not current - ensures consistent envelope)
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseFreq, now);

        // Attack: ramp to peak frequency
        filter.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(peakFreq, now + a);

        // Decay: ramp to sustain frequency
        filter.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(sustainFreq, now + a + d);

        appliedCount++;
        console.log('FILTER ENV applied to filter ' + idx + ': ' + currentFreq.toFixed(0) + ' → ' + peakFreq.toFixed(0) + ' → ' + sustainFreq.toFixed(0));
      }
    });

    console.log('FILTER ENV: Applied to ' + appliedCount + ' filter nodes');
  }

  /**
   * Apply filter envelope release phase
   * Called when a note stops - ramps frequency back to base
   * @param {Object} filterChain - Filter chain from createFilterChain()
   * @param {Object} filterSettings - Filter settings from getFilterSettings()
   * @param {Object} filterEnvSettings - Filter envelope settings from getFilterEnvSettings()
   * @param {AudioContext} ctx - Web Audio context
   */
  function applyFilterEnvelopeRelease(filterChain, filterSettings, filterEnvSettings, ctx) {
    if (!filterEnvSettings.enabled || !filterChain || !filterChain.filters) return;

    const now = ctx.currentTime;
    const baseFreq = filterSettings.frequency;
    const r = filterEnvSettings.release / 1000;

    console.log('applyFilterEnvelopeRelease: returning to base=' + baseFreq.toFixed(0) + 'Hz over ' + r.toFixed(3) + 's');

    filterChain.filters.forEach(filter => {
      if (filter instanceof BiquadFilterNode) {
        // Cancel scheduled values and start from current position
        filter.frequency.cancelScheduledValues(now);
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(filter.frequency.value, now);

        // Release: ramp back to base frequency
        filter.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(baseFreq, now + r);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ADSR Envelope Calculation
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Calculate ADSR envelope value at a given time
   * Used for buffer-based synthesis methods
   * @param {number} t - Current time in seconds
   * @param {number} dur - Total note duration in seconds
   * @param {{a: number, d: number, s: number, r: number}} adsr - ADSR parameters
   * @returns {number} Envelope amplitude (0-1)
   */
  function calcADSR(t, dur, adsr) {
    const { a, d, s, r } = adsr;
    const sustainEnd = Math.max(0, dur - r);

    // Attack phase
    if (t < a) {
      return t / a;
    }
    // Decay phase
    if (t < a + d) {
      return 1 - (1 - s) * ((t - a) / d);
    }
    // Sustain phase
    if (t < sustainEnd) {
      return s;
    }
    // Release phase
    if (t < dur) {
      return s * (1 - (t - sustainEnd) / r);
    }
    return 0;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Note Playback
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Play a note with full synthesis
   * Supports multiple synthesis methods: oscillator, band-limited, naive, worklet
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   * @param {number} [dur] - Duration in seconds (default from constants)
   */
  function playNote(midi, dur) {
    dur = dur || SL.DURATION || 0.4;

    const f = m2f(midi);
    const m = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const adsr = getADSR();
    const oscSet = getOscSettings();
    const filterSettings = getFilterSettings();
    const sr = SL.SR || 44100;
    const TWO_PI = SL.TWO_PI || (2 * Math.PI);

    console.log('playNote called - MIDI:', midi, 'method:', m);
    console.log('playNote oscSet:', JSON.stringify(oscSet));
    console.log('playNote filterSettings:', JSON.stringify(filterSettings));

    // Visual feedback
    highlightNote(midi, true);
    setTimeout(() => highlightNote(midi, false), dur * 1000);

    // Update key-tracked frequency display
    if (SL.ui && SL.ui.updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay) {
      SL.ui.updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay(f);
    }

    const c = getCtx();

    // AudioWorklet synthesis - runs on dedicated audio thread
    if (m === 'worklet') {
      if (isWorkletAvailable()) {
        const refHz = parseFloat(document.getElementById('refHz').value) || 440;
        // Convert oscSet to worklet format (levels as 0-1)
        const workletOscSet = oscSet.map(os => ({
          wave: os.wave,
          oct: os.oct,
          detune: os.detune,
          level: os.level, // Already 0-1 from getOscSettings
          pulseWidth: os.pulseWidth,
          superSawSpread: os.superSawSpread
        }));
        workletNoteOn(midi, dur, workletOscSet, adsr, refHz);
      } else {
        // Fallback to band-limited synthesis if worklet unavailable
        console.warn('Worklet not available, falling back to band-limited synthesis');
        playNoteFallback(midi, dur, adsr, oscSet, filterSettings, sr, TWO_PI, c);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (m === 'oscillator') {
      // Real-time oscillator synthesis with ADSR automation
      const now = c.currentTime;
      const peak = 0.12;
      const { a, d, s, r } = adsr;
      // Minimum 3ms attack to prevent clicks
      const attackTime = Math.max(0.003, a);
      const sustainEnd = Math.max(attackTime + d, dur - r);
      const filterEnvSettings = getFilterEnvSettings();

      // Master gain for envelope
      const master = c.createGain();
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, now + attackTime);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak * s, now + attackTime + d);
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(peak * s, now + sustainEnd);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        master.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());

        // Apply filter envelope if enabled
        applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
      } else {
        master.connect(getFinalDestination());
      }

      // Apply filter envelope to continuous noise filter too (for sequencer playback)
      // Use key-tracked cutoff so noise follows the same frequency as oscillators
      if (continuousNoiseFilter && filterEnvSettings.enabled) {
        updateContinuousNoiseFilterFreq(keyTrackedFreq);
        applyFilterEnvelope(continuousNoiseFilter, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);

        // Schedule release based on note duration
        setTimeout(() => {
          applyFilterEnvelopeRelease(continuousNoiseFilter, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
        }, Math.max(0, (dur - filterEnvSettings.release / 1000)) * 1000);
      }

      // Create oscillators from mixer settings
      oscSet.forEach(os => {
        if (os.level <= 0) return;

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);

        if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
          // Super saw: create 7 detuned sawtooth oscillators
          const superSawOscs = createSuperSawOscillators(c, oscFreq, os.superSawSpread, master, os.level);
          superSawOscs.forEach(osc => {
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(now + dur + 0.01);
          });
        } else if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
          // Pulse (PWM): use PeriodicWave
          const o = c.createOscillator();
          const g = c.createGain();
          const pulseWave = createPulseWave(c, os.pulseWidth);

          o.setPeriodicWave(pulseWave);
          o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
          g.gain.value = os.level;

          o.connect(g);
          g.connect(master);
          o.start();
          o.stop(now + dur + 0.01);
        } else {
          // Standard waveforms
          const o = c.createOscillator();
          const g = c.createGain();

          o.type = os.wave;
          o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
          g.gain.value = os.level;

          o.connect(g);
          g.connect(master);
          o.start();
          o.stop(now + dur + 0.01);
        }
      });

    } else if (m === 'bandlimited') {
      // Band-limited synthesis using WAVETABLE LOOKUP (much faster than additive)
      const n = Math.floor(sr * dur);
      const b = acquireBuffer(n);
      const filterEnvSettings = getFilterEnvSettings();

      // Pre-compute envelope curve once for all oscillators (major optimization)
      const envCurve = getEnvelopeCurve(dur, adsr, sr);

      // Generate and mix all active oscillators using wavetables
      oscSet.forEach(os => {
        if (os.level <= 0) return;

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);

        // Use wavetable for standard waveforms
        if (WAVETABLE_WAVES.includes(os.wave) && wavetablesInitialized) {
          // Fast wavetable synthesis
          const table = getWavetableForFreq(os.wave, oscFreq);
          if (table) {
            const phaseInc = oscFreq / sr;
            let phase = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
              // Use pre-computed envelope (array index instead of function call)
              const env = envCurve[i];
              const sample = sampleWavetable(table, phase);
              b[i] += sample * env * os.level;

              phase += phaseInc;
              if (phase >= 1) phase -= 1;
            }
            return; // Done with this oscillator
          }
        }

        // Fallback for pulse, supersaw, or if wavetables not ready
        const mH = Math.min(maxH(oscFreq), 48);

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const t = i / sr;
          const ph = TWO_PI * oscFreq * t;
          // Use pre-computed envelope (array index instead of function call)
          const env = envCurve[i];
          let sample = 0;

          if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
            // Pulse wave: band-limited using variable duty cycle Fourier series
            const pw = os.pulseWidth / 100;
            for (let h = 1; h <= mH; h++) {
              const harmAmp = (2 / (h * Math.PI)) * fastSin(h * Math.PI * pw);
              sample += harmAmp * fastSin(ph * h);
            }
          } else if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
            // Super saw: 7 detuned sawtooth voices using wavetable
            const spreadFactor = os.superSawSpread / 50;
            const sawTable = getWavetableForFreq('sawtooth', oscFreq);

            if (sawTable && wavetablesInitialized) {
              // Fast supersaw using wavetable
              SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
                const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
                const voiceFreq = oscFreq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);
                const voicePhase = ((voiceFreq * t) % 1 + 1) % 1;
                sample += sampleWavetable(sawTable, voicePhase) / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length;
              });
            } else {
              // Fallback additive supersaw
              SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
                const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
                const voiceFreq = oscFreq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);
                const voicePh = TWO_PI * voiceFreq * t;
                const voiceMH = Math.min(maxH(voiceFreq), 48);
                let voiceSample = 0;
                for (let h = 1; h <= voiceMH; h++) {
                  voiceSample += fastSin(voicePh * h) / h;
                }
                voiceSample *= 2 / Math.PI;
                sample += voiceSample / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length;
              });
            }
          } else {
            // Fallback for unknown waveforms - use triangle
            let sg = 1;
            for (let h = 1; h <= mH; h += 2) {
              sample += sg * Math.cos(ph * h) / (h * h);
              sg = -sg;
            }
            sample *= 8 / (Math.PI * Math.PI);
          }

          b[i] += sample * env * os.level;
        }
      });

      const ab = c.createBuffer(1, n, sr);
      ab.copyToChannel(b, 0);
      releaseBuffer(b); // Return buffer to pool after copying to AudioBuffer
      const src = c.createBufferSource();
      const g = c.createGain();
      g.gain.value = 0.12;
      src.buffer = ab;
      src.connect(g);

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        g.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());

        // Apply filter envelope if enabled
        applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
      } else {
        g.connect(getFinalDestination());
      }

      // Apply filter envelope to continuous noise filter too
      if (continuousNoiseFilter && filterEnvSettings.enabled) {
        updateContinuousNoiseFilterFreq(keyTrackedFreq);
        applyFilterEnvelope(continuousNoiseFilter, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);

        // Schedule release based on note duration
        setTimeout(() => {
          applyFilterEnvelopeRelease(continuousNoiseFilter, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
        }, Math.max(0, (dur - filterEnvSettings.release / 1000)) * 1000);
      }

      src.start();

    } else {
      // PolyBLEP synthesis (anti-aliased waveforms) - supports all 3 oscillators
      const n = Math.floor(sr * dur);
      const b = acquireBuffer(n);
      const filterEnvSettings = getFilterEnvSettings();

      // Pre-compute envelope curve once for all oscillators (major optimization)
      const envCurve = getEnvelopeCurve(dur, adsr, sr);

      // Generate and mix all active oscillators
      oscSet.forEach(os => {
        if (os.level <= 0) return;

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);
        const dt = oscFreq / sr; // Phase increment for PolyBLEP

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const t = i / sr;
          const ph = TWO_PI * oscFreq * t;
          const phase = (t * oscFreq) % 1; // Normalized phase [0, 1)
          // Use pre-computed envelope (array index instead of function call)
          const env = envCurve[i];
          let sample = 0;

          if (os.wave === 'sine') {
            sample = fastSin(ph);
          } else if (os.wave === 'square') {
            // PolyBLEP square wave
            sample = polyBlepSquare(phase, dt);
          } else if (os.wave === 'sawtooth') {
            // PolyBLEP sawtooth wave
            sample = polyBlepSaw(phase, dt);
          } else if (os.wave === 'triangle') {
            // PolyBLEP triangle wave
            sample = polyBlepTriangle(phase, dt);
          } else if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
            // PolyBLEP pulse wave with variable width
            const pw = os.pulseWidth / 100;
            sample = polyBlepPulse(phase, dt, pw);
          } else if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
            // PolyBLEP super saw: 7 detuned sawtooth waves
            const spreadFactor = os.superSawSpread / 50;
            SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
              const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
              const voiceFreq = oscFreq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);
              const voiceDt = voiceFreq / sr;
              const voicePhase = (t * voiceFreq) % 1;
              const voiceSample = polyBlepSaw(voicePhase, voiceDt);
              sample += voiceSample / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length;
            });
          } else {
            // Default to PolyBLEP triangle
            sample = polyBlepTriangle(phase, dt);
          }

          b[i] += sample * env * os.level;
        }
      });

      const ab = c.createBuffer(1, n, sr);
      ab.copyToChannel(b, 0);
      releaseBuffer(b); // Return buffer to pool after copying to AudioBuffer
      const src = c.createBufferSource();
      const g = c.createGain();
      g.gain.value = 0.12;
      src.buffer = ab;
      src.connect(g);

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        g.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());

        // Apply filter envelope if enabled
        applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
      } else {
        g.connect(getFinalDestination());
      }

      // Apply filter envelope to continuous noise filter too
      if (continuousNoiseFilter && filterEnvSettings.enabled) {
        updateContinuousNoiseFilterFreq(keyTrackedFreq);
        applyFilterEnvelope(continuousNoiseFilter, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);

        // Schedule release based on note duration
        setTimeout(() => {
          applyFilterEnvelopeRelease(continuousNoiseFilter, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
        }, Math.max(0, (dur - filterEnvSettings.release / 1000)) * 1000);
      }

      src.start();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Start a sustained note (for keyboard/mouse hold)
   * Creates oscillators from mixer settings that play until explicitly stopped
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   */
  function startSustainedNote(midi) {
    const activeOscs = getActiveOscillators();
    if (activeOscs.has(midi)) return;

    const c = getCtx();
    const f = m2f(midi);
    const oscSet = getOscSettings();
    const filterSettings = getFilterSettings();
    const noiseSettings = getNoiseSettings();
    const filterEnvSettings = getFilterEnvSettings();

    console.log('startSustainedNote: MIDI', midi, 'freq', f, '(using voice pool)');

    // Get ADSR for attack ramp
    const adsr = getADSR();
    const now = c.currentTime;
    const peak = 0.12;
    // Minimum 3ms attack to prevent clicks even when attack slider is at 0
    const attackTime = Math.max(0.003, adsr.a);

    // Acquire a voice from the pool
    const voice = acquireVoice(currentInstrument, midi);

    // Apply attack envelope to avoid click
    voice.masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
    voice.masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, now + attackTime);

    // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
    const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
    const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

    // Create filter chain (can't easily pool biquads due to state)
    const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
    voice.filterChain = filterChain;
    voice.filterSettings = adjustedFilterSettings;
    voice.filterEnvSettings = filterEnvSettings;

    if (filterChain) {
      voice.masterGain.connect(filterChain.input);
      filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());
      applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
    } else {
      voice.masterGain.connect(getFinalDestination());
    }

    // Create noise source if enabled
    if (noiseSettings.enabled) {
      const noiseNode = createNoiseSource(c, noiseSettings);
      if (noiseNode) {
        noiseNode.gain.connect(voice.masterGain);
        noiseNode.source.start();
        voice.noiseNode = noiseNode;
        console.log('Noise source started: type=' + noiseSettings.type);
      }
    }

    // Create oscillators (can't be pooled - one-shot in Web Audio)
    // But we use pooled gain nodes where possible
    oscSet.forEach((os, idx) => {
      if (os.level <= 0) return;

      const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);

      if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
        // Super saw: create 7 detuned sawtooth oscillators
        const superSawOscs = createSuperSawOscillators(c, oscFreq, os.superSawSpread, voice.masterGain, os.level);
        superSawOscs.forEach(osc => {
          osc.start();
          voice.oscillators.push({ osc: osc, gain: null });
        });
      } else if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
        // Pulse (PWM): use PeriodicWave
        const o = c.createOscillator();
        const pulseWave = createPulseWave(c, os.pulseWidth);
        o.setPeriodicWave(pulseWave);
        o.frequency.value = oscFreq;

        // Use pooled gain node if available, otherwise create
        const g = idx < voice.oscGains.length ? voice.oscGains[idx] : c.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(os.level, c.currentTime);
        g.disconnect();
        g.connect(voice.masterGain);

        o.connect(g);
        o.start();
        voice.oscillators.push({ osc: o, gain: g });
      } else {
        // Standard waveforms
        const o = c.createOscillator();
        o.type = os.wave;
        o.frequency.value = oscFreq;

        // Use pooled gain node if available
        const g = idx < voice.oscGains.length ? voice.oscGains[idx] : c.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(os.level, c.currentTime);
        g.disconnect();
        g.connect(voice.masterGain);

        o.connect(g);
        o.start();
        voice.oscillators.push({ osc: o, gain: g });
      }
    });

    console.log('Voice', voice.id, ': created', voice.oscillators.length, 'oscillators');
    console.log('[AUDIO] Voice routing: filter=' + !!filterChain + ' ctx.state=' + c.state + ' effectChain=' + !!effectChain + ' masterOutput=' + !!(instruments[currentInstrument] && instruments[currentInstrument].masterOutput));

    // Store voice reference in activeOscs for compatibility
    activeOscs.set(midi, {
      voice,
      oscillators: voice.oscillators,
      master: voice.masterGain,
      filterChain: voice.filterChain,
      noiseNode: voice.noiseNode,
      filterSettings: adjustedFilterSettings,
      filterEnvSettings
    });
    highlightNote(midi, true);

    // Update note display
    if (SL.keyboard && SL.keyboard.updateNoteReadout) {
      SL.keyboard.updateNoteReadout(midi);
    }

    // Update key-tracked frequency display
    if (SL.ui && SL.ui.updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay) {
      SL.ui.updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay(f);
    }

    // Apply filter envelope to continuous noise filter
    if (continuousNoiseFilter && filterEnvSettings.enabled) {
      updateContinuousNoiseFilterFreq(keyTrackedFreq);
      applyFilterEnvelope(continuousNoiseFilter, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update continuous noise filter base frequency (for key tracking)
   * @param {number} freq - New cutoff frequency
   */
  function updateContinuousNoiseFilterFreq(freq) {
    if (!continuousNoiseFilter || !continuousNoiseFilter.filters) return;
    continuousNoiseFilter.filters.forEach(filter => {
      if (filter instanceof BiquadFilterNode) {
        // Set the base frequency - envelope will modulate from here
        filter.frequency.value = freq;
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Stop a sustained note
   * Applies a quick exponential ramp to avoid clicks
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   */
  function stopSustainedNote(midi) {
    const activeOscs = getActiveOscillators();
    const node = activeOscs.get(midi);
    if (node) {
      const c = getCtx();

      // Apply filter envelope release if enabled
      if (node.filterChain && node.filterSettings && node.filterEnvSettings) {
        applyFilterEnvelopeRelease(node.filterChain, node.filterSettings, node.filterEnvSettings, c);
      }

      // If using voice pool, release the voice
      if (node.voice) {
        releaseVoice(node.voice, false);
      } else {
        // Legacy path for non-pooled voices
        node.master.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, c.currentTime + 0.05);
        node.oscillators.forEach(o => o.osc.stop(c.currentTime + 0.06));
        if (node.noiseNode && node.noiseNode.source) {
          try { node.noiseNode.source.stop(c.currentTime + 0.06); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
        }
      }

      activeOscs.delete(midi);
      highlightNote(midi, false);

      // Clear key-tracked frequency display if no more notes are playing
      if (activeOscs.size === 0 && SL.ui && SL.ui.updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay) {
        SL.ui.updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay(null);
      }

      // Apply filter envelope release to continuous noise filter too
      if (activeOscs.size === 0 && continuousNoiseFilter && node.filterEnvSettings && node.filterEnvSettings.enabled) {
        applyFilterEnvelopeRelease(continuousNoiseFilter, node.filterSettings, node.filterEnvSettings, c);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Start a sustained chord (multiple notes)
   * @param {number[]} notes - Array of MIDI note numbers
   * @param {string} name - Chord name for display
   * @param {HTMLElement} [btn] - Button element to highlight
   */
  function startSustainedChord(notes, name, btn) {
    if (btn) btn.classList.add('playing');
    notes.forEach(midi => startSustainedNote(midi));

    // Update display if available
    const noteReadout = document.getElementById('noteReadout');
    if (noteReadout && SL.keyboard) {
      const noteNames = notes.map(midi => SL.keyboard.midiToName(midi)).join(', ');
      noteReadout.textContent = name + ' (' + noteNames + ')';
    }
  }

  /**
   * Stop all currently sustained notes
   * Called on global mouseup to clean up
   */
  function stopAllSustained() {
    const activeOscs = getActiveOscillators();
    activeOscs.forEach((node, midi) => stopSustainedNote(midi));
  }

  /**
   * Refresh all active oscillators with current mixer settings
   * Called when any mixer control (wave, oct, detune, level) changes
   * Stops and restarts all currently playing notes with new settings
   */
  function refreshActiveOscillators() {
    console.log('refreshActiveOscillators called');

    const activeOscs = getActiveOscillators();

    // Get list of currently playing MIDI notes
    const activeMidis = Array.from(activeOscs.keys());
    console.log('Active MIDI notes:', activeMidis);

    if (activeMidis.length === 0) {
      console.log('No active notes, returning early');
      return;
    }

    // Stop all current oscillators silently (quick fade)
    const c = getCtx();
    activeOscs.forEach((node, midi) => {
      node.master.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, c.currentTime + 0.02);
      node.oscillators.forEach(o => o.osc.stop(c.currentTime + 0.03));
      // Stop noise if active
      if (node.noiseNode && node.noiseNode.source) {
        try { node.noiseNode.source.stop(c.currentTime + 0.03); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      }
    });
    activeOscs.clear();
    console.log('Stopped old oscillators');

    // Get fresh settings and restart all notes
    const oscSet = getOscSettings();
    const filterSettings = getFilterSettings();
    const noiseSettings = getNoiseSettings();
    const filterEnvSettings = getFilterEnvSettings();
    console.log('Fresh oscillator settings:', oscSet);
    console.log('Fresh filter settings:', filterSettings);
    console.log('Fresh filter envelope settings:', filterEnvSettings);

    activeMidis.forEach(midi => {
      // Recreate oscillators with current settings
      const f = m2f(midi);
      console.log('Recreating oscillators for MIDI', midi, 'freq', f);

      const master = c.createGain();
      master.gain.value = 0.12;

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect to destination
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        master.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());

        // Apply filter envelope if enabled (note: this restarts envelope from beginning)
        applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
      } else {
        master.connect(getFinalDestination());
      }

      // Create noise source if enabled
      // Noise connects to master gain (same signal path as oscillators)
      let noiseNode = null;
      if (noiseSettings.enabled) {
        noiseNode = createNoiseSource(c, noiseSettings);
        if (noiseNode) {
          // Connect noise to master gain (same path as oscillators -> filter -> output)
          noiseNode.gain.connect(master);
          noiseNode.source.start();
        }
      }

      const oscillators = [];
      oscSet.forEach((os, idx) => {
        if (os.level <= 0) {
          console.log('  Skipping OSC ' + (idx + 1) + ' - level is 0');
          return;
        }

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);
        console.log('  Creating OSC ' + (idx + 1) + ': wave=' + os.wave + ', freq=' + oscFreq + ', level=' + os.level);

        if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
          // Super saw: create 7 detuned sawtooth oscillators
          const superSawOscs = createSuperSawOscillators(c, oscFreq, os.superSawSpread, master, os.level);
          superSawOscs.forEach(osc => {
            osc.start();
            oscillators.push({ osc: osc, gain: null }); // No individual gain control
          });
        } else if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
          // Pulse (PWM): use PeriodicWave
          const o = c.createOscillator();
          const g = c.createGain();
          const pulseWave = createPulseWave(c, os.pulseWidth);

          o.setPeriodicWave(pulseWave);
          o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
          g.gain.value = os.level;

          o.connect(g);
          g.connect(master);
          o.start();

          oscillators.push({ osc: o, gain: g });
        } else {
          // Standard waveforms
          const o = c.createOscillator();
          const g = c.createGain();

          o.type = os.wave;
          o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
          g.gain.value = os.level;

          o.connect(g);
          g.connect(master);
          o.start();

          oscillators.push({ osc: o, gain: g });
        }
      });

      console.log('Created ' + oscillators.length + ' oscillators for MIDI', midi);
      activeOscs.set(midi, {
        oscillators,
        master,
        filterChain,
        noiseNode,
        filterSettings: adjustedFilterSettings,
        filterEnvSettings
      });
      highlightNote(midi, true);
    });
  }

  /**
   * Update filter parameters on all active notes in real-time
   * Called when filter controls change to smoothly sweep filter
   * Handles different filter models appropriately
   */
  function refreshFilter() {
    const filterSettings = getFilterSettings();
    const c = getCtx();
    const model = filterSettings.model || 'butterworth';
    const activeOscs = getActiveOscillators();

    // Update filters on active oscillator notes
    activeOscs.forEach((node, midi) => {
      if (node.filterChain && node.filterChain.filters) {
        updateFilterChainParams(node.filterChain.filters, filterSettings, model, c);
      }
    });

    // Also update continuous noise filter in real-time
    if (continuousNoiseFilter && continuousNoiseFilter.filters) {
      updateFilterChainParams(continuousNoiseFilter.filters, filterSettings, model, c);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Helper to update parameters on a filter chain
   */
  function updateFilterChainParams(filters, filterSettings, model, c) {
    filters.forEach((filter, idx) => {
      // Only update BiquadFilterNodes (skip GainNodes and WaveShapers)
      if (filter instanceof BiquadFilterNode) {
        // Smoothly ramp to new frequency for smooth sweeps
        filter.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(
          filterSettings.frequency,
          c.currentTime + 0.02
        );

        // Calculate Q based on model and stage
        let qValue;
        switch (model) {
          case 'moog':
            // Moog: progressive Q through stages
            const resonanceFactor = Math.pow(filterSettings.resonance / 10, 0.7);
            const biquadIndex = filters
              .slice(0, idx + 1)
              .filter(f => f instanceof BiquadFilterNode).length;
            const numBiquads = filters
              .filter(f => f instanceof BiquadFilterNode).length;
            qValue = 0.5 + (resonanceFactor * biquadIndex / numBiquads) * 8;
            qValue = Math.min(qValue, 20);
            break;

          case 'svf':
            // SVF: linear Q scaling
            const svfQ = 0.5 + (filterSettings.resonance * 2.5);
            qValue = idx === 0 ? svfQ : svfQ * 0.8;
            break;

          case 'ms20':
            // MS-20: aggressive exponential Q
            const aggressiveQ = 0.5 + Math.pow(filterSettings.resonance / 5, 1.8) * 25;
            qValue = idx === 0 ? Math.min(aggressiveQ, 30) : Math.min(aggressiveQ * 1.2, 35);
            break;

          case 'oberheim':
            // Oberheim: smooth sqrt Q curve
            const semQ = 0.7 + Math.sqrt(filterSettings.resonance) * 2.5;
            qValue = idx === 0 ? semQ : semQ * 0.9;
            // Also update frequency offset for second stage
            if (idx === 1) {
              filter.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(
                filterSettings.frequency * 0.97,
                c.currentTime + 0.02
              );
            }
            break;

          case 'butterworth':
          default:
            qValue = idx === 0 ? filterSettings.resonance : Math.max(0.1, filterSettings.resonance * 0.707);
            break;
        }

        filter.Q.value = qValue;

        // Update type (but not for Moog internal stages which stay lowpass)
        if (model !== 'moog' || idx === filters.length - 1) {
          filter.type = filterSettings.type;
        }
      }

      // Update GainNode for MS-20 input boost
      if (filter instanceof GainNode && model === 'ms20') {
        filter.gain.value = 1.0 + (filterSettings.resonance / 30);
      }

      // Update WaveShaper curve for MS-20
      if (filter instanceof WaveShaperNode && model === 'ms20') {
        filter.curve = createMS20SaturationCurve(filterSettings.resonance);
      }
    });
  }

  /**
   * Stop a sustained chord
   * @param {number[]} notes - Array of MIDI note numbers
   * @param {HTMLElement} [btn] - Button element to unhighlight
   */
  function stopSustainedChord(notes, btn) {
    if (btn) btn.classList.remove('playing');
    notes.forEach(midi => stopSustainedNote(midi));
  }
