  // Visual Feedback
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Highlight a note on keyboard/grid visuals
   * Updates playingNotes set and toggles CSS classes
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   * @param {boolean} on - true to highlight, false to unhighlight
   */
  function highlightNote(midi, on) {
    const playing = getPlayingNotes();
    if (on) {
      playing.add(midi);
    } else {
      playing.delete(midi);
    }

    // Update keyboard keys
    document.querySelectorAll('.key').forEach(k => {
      if (parseInt(k.dataset.note) === midi) {
        k.classList.toggle('playing', on);
      }
    });

    // Update isomorphic grid keys
    document.querySelectorAll('.iso-key').forEach(k => {
      if (parseInt(k.dataset.midi) === midi) {
        k.classList.toggle('playing', on);
      }
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Continuous Noise Generator
  // ============================================================

  /** Continuous noise source (independent of note playback) */
  let continuousNoiseSource = null;
  let continuousNoiseGain = null;
  let continuousNoiseFilter = null;

  /**
   * Start or update the continuous noise generator
   * Noise plays independently of notes and goes through the filter
   */
  function startContinuousNoise() {
    const c = getCtx();
    const noiseSettings = getNoiseSettings();
    const filterSettings = getFilterSettings();

    // If noise level is 0, stop any existing noise
    if (noiseSettings.level <= 0) {
      stopContinuousNoise();
      return;
    }

    // If already running, just update the gain
    if (continuousNoiseSource && continuousNoiseGain) {
      // Update gain (scale up to be comparable to oscillators)
      continuousNoiseGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(noiseSettings.level * 0.5, c.currentTime, 0.02);
      return;
    }

    // Create new noise source
    const buffer = getNoiseBuffer(c, noiseSettings.type);
    continuousNoiseSource = c.createBufferSource();
    continuousNoiseSource.buffer = buffer;
    continuousNoiseSource.loop = true;

    // Create gain node (scale up to be comparable to oscillators)
    continuousNoiseGain = c.createGain();
    continuousNoiseGain.gain.value = noiseSettings.level * 0.5;

    // Connect: noise -> gain -> filter -> destination
    continuousNoiseSource.connect(continuousNoiseGain);

    // Create filter chain if enabled
    if (filterSettings.enabled) {
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, filterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        continuousNoiseGain.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());
        continuousNoiseFilter = filterChain;
      } else {
        continuousNoiseGain.connect(getFinalDestination());
      }
    } else {
      continuousNoiseGain.connect(getFinalDestination());
    }

    continuousNoiseSource.start();
    console.log('Continuous noise started: type=' + noiseSettings.type + ', level=' + noiseSettings.level);
  }

  /**
   * Stop the continuous noise generator
   */
  function stopContinuousNoise() {
    if (continuousNoiseSource) {
      try { continuousNoiseSource.stop(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      continuousNoiseSource = null;
    }
    if (continuousNoiseGain) {
      continuousNoiseGain.disconnect();
      continuousNoiseGain = null;
    }
    continuousNoiseFilter = null;
    console.log('Continuous noise stopped');
  }

  /**
   * Update continuous noise settings (type, level, filter)
   * Called when noise controls change
   */
  function updateContinuousNoise() {
    const noiseSettings = getNoiseSettings();

    // If level is 0, stop noise
    if (noiseSettings.level <= 0) {
      stopContinuousNoise();
      return;
    }

    // If noise type changed, restart with new type
    if (continuousNoiseSource) {
      // Just update gain for now
      if (continuousNoiseGain) {
        const c = getCtx();
        continuousNoiseGain.gain.setTargetAtTime(noiseSettings.level * 0.5, c.currentTime, 0.02);
      }
    } else {
      // Start noise if not running
      startContinuousNoise();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Restart continuous noise with new type
   * Called when noise type radio button changes
   */
  function restartContinuousNoise() {
    const wasRunning = continuousNoiseSource !== null;
    stopContinuousNoise();
    if (wasRunning || getNoiseSettings().level > 0) {
      startContinuousNoise();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update continuous noise filter settings
   * Called when filter controls change
   */
  function updateContinuousNoiseFilter() {
    if (!continuousNoiseGain) return;

    const c = getCtx();
    const filterSettings = getFilterSettings();

    // Disconnect current routing
    continuousNoiseGain.disconnect();

    // Reconnect with new filter settings
    if (filterSettings.enabled) {
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, filterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        continuousNoiseGain.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(getFinalDestination());
        continuousNoiseFilter = filterChain;
      } else {
        continuousNoiseGain.connect(getFinalDestination());
        continuousNoiseFilter = null;
      }
    } else {
      continuousNoiseGain.connect(getFinalDestination());
      continuousNoiseFilter = null;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Multi-Instrument Management
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Get the current instrument's settings
   * @returns {Object} Current instrument's settings object
   */
  function getInstrumentSettings() {
    return instruments[currentInstrument].settings;
  }

  /**
   * Get settings for a specific instrument by ID
   * For current instrument, saves UI to cache first to ensure up-to-date
   * @param {number} instId - Instrument index (0-3)
   * @returns {Object} Instrument's settings object
   */
  function getSettingsForInstrument(instId) {
    if (instId < 0 || instId >= NUM_INSTRUMENTS) {
      return instruments[currentInstrument].settings;
    }
    // If requesting current instrument, save UI to cache first
    if (instId === currentInstrument) {
      saveInstrumentSettings(instId);
    }
    return instruments[instId].settings;
  }

  /**
   * Play a note using a specific instrument's settings
   * Used by sequencer to play notes on their assigned instruments
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   * @param {number} dur - Duration in seconds
   * @param {number} instId - Instrument index (0-3)
   */
  function playNoteOnInstrument(midi, dur, instId) {
    dur = dur || SL.DURATION || 0.4;

    // Get settings for the specified instrument
    const settings = getSettingsForInstrument(instId);
    const inst = instruments[instId];

    const f = m2f(midi);
    const m = document.getElementById('method').value;
    const sr = SL.SR || 44100;
    const TWO_PI = SL.TWO_PI || (2 * Math.PI);

    // Convert cached ADSR values (slider values) to seconds
    const adsr = {
      a: sliderToTime(settings.adsr.a, 500, 500) / 1000,
      d: sliderToTime(settings.adsr.d, 500, 500) / 1000,
      s: settings.adsr.s / 100,
      r: sliderToTime(settings.adsr.r, 1000, 1000) / 1000
    };

    // Convert cached oscillator settings
    const oscSet = settings.osc.map(os => ({
      wave: os.wave,
      oct: os.oct,
      detune: os.detune,
      level: os.level / 100,
      pulseWidth: os.pulseWidth,
      superSawSpread: os.superSawSpread
    }));

    // Convert cached filter settings
    const filterSettings = {
      enabled: settings.filter.enabled,
      type: settings.filter.type,
      frequency: sliderToFreq(settings.filter.freq),
      resonance: sliderToQ(settings.filter.q),
      keyTrack: settings.filter.keyTrack,
      model: settings.filter.model,
      slope: settings.filter.slope
    };

    // Convert cached filter envelope settings
    const filterEnvSettings = {
      enabled: settings.filterEnv.enabled,
      amount: settings.filterEnv.amount,
      attack: sliderToTime(settings.filterEnv.a, 2000, 2000) / 1000,
      decay: sliderToTime(settings.filterEnv.d, 2000, 2000) / 1000,
      sustain: settings.filterEnv.s / 100,
      release: sliderToTime(settings.filterEnv.r, 3000, 3000) / 1000,
      link: settings.filterEnv.link
    };

    // Visual feedback
    highlightNote(midi, true);
    setTimeout(() => highlightNote(midi, false), dur * 1000);

    const c = getCtx();

    // Get the instrument's master output (route to correct instrument)
    const destination = inst.masterOutput || getFinalDestination();

    // AudioWorklet synthesis
    if (m === 'worklet') {
      if (isWorkletAvailable()) {
        const refHz = parseFloat(document.getElementById('refHz').value) || 440;
        workletNoteOn(midi, dur, oscSet, adsr, refHz);
      } else {
        // Fallback to band-limited synthesis
        console.warn('Worklet not available, falling back to band-limited synthesis');
        playNoteFallbackWithDestination(midi, dur, adsr, oscSet, filterSettings, filterEnvSettings, sr, TWO_PI, c, destination);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (m === 'oscillator') {
      // Real-time oscillator synthesis with ADSR automation
      const now = c.currentTime;
      const peak = 0.12;
      const { a, d, s, r } = adsr;
      const sustainEnd = Math.max(a + d, dur - r);

      // Master gain for envelope
      const master = c.createGain();
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(0, now);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak, now + a);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(peak * s, now + a + d);
      master.gain.setValueAtTime(peak * s, now + sustainEnd);
      master.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + dur);

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect to instrument's output
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        master.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(destination);
      } else {
        master.connect(destination);
      }

      // Create oscillators from mixer settings
      oscSet.forEach(os => {
        if (os.level <= 0) return;

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);

        if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
          const superSawOscs = createSuperSawOscillators(c, oscFreq, os.superSawSpread, master, os.level);
          superSawOscs.forEach(osc => {
            osc.start();
            osc.stop(now + dur + 0.01);
          });
        } else if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
          const o = c.createOscillator();
          const g = c.createGain();
          const pulseWave = createPulseWave(c, os.pulseWidth);
          o.setPeriodicWave(pulseWave);
          o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
          g.gain.value = os.level;
          o.connect(g);
          g.connect(master);
          o.start();
          o.stop(now + dur + 0.01);
        } else {
          const o = c.createOscillator();
          o.type = os.wave;
          o.frequency.value = oscFreq;
          const g = c.createGain();
          g.gain.value = os.level;
          o.connect(g);
          g.connect(master);
          o.start();
          o.stop(now + dur + 0.01);
        }
      });
    } else if (m === 'bandlimited') {
      // Band-limited synthesis using WAVETABLE LOOKUP
      const n = Math.floor(sr * dur);
      const b = acquireBuffer(n);

      // Pre-compute envelope curve once for all oscillators (major optimization)
      const envCurve = getEnvelopeCurve(dur, adsr, sr);

      // Generate and mix all active oscillators using wavetables
      oscSet.forEach(os => {
        if (os.level <= 0) return;

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);

        // Use wavetable for standard waveforms
        if (WAVETABLE_WAVES.includes(os.wave) && wavetablesInitialized) {
          const table = getWavetableForFreq(os.wave, oscFreq);
          if (table) {
            const phaseInc = oscFreq / sr;
            let phase = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
              // Use pre-computed envelope (array index instead of function call)
              const env = envCurve[i];
              const sample = sampleWavetable(table, phase);
              b[i] += sample * env * os.level;

              phase += phaseInc;
              if (phase >= 1) phase -= 1;
            }
            return;
          }
        }

        // Fallback for pulse, supersaw, or if wavetables not ready
        const mH = Math.min(maxH(oscFreq), 48);

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const t = i / sr;
          const ph = TWO_PI * oscFreq * t;
          // Use pre-computed envelope (array index instead of function call)
          const env = envCurve[i];
          let sample = 0;

          if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
            const pw = os.pulseWidth / 100;
            for (let h = 1; h <= mH; h++) {
              const harmAmp = (2 / (h * Math.PI)) * fastSin(h * Math.PI * pw);
              sample += harmAmp * fastSin(ph * h);
            }
          } else if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
            const spreadFactor = os.superSawSpread / 50;
            const sawTable = getWavetableForFreq('sawtooth', oscFreq);

            if (sawTable && wavetablesInitialized) {
              SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
                const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
                const voiceFreq = oscFreq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);
                const voicePhase = ((voiceFreq * t) % 1 + 1) % 1;
                sample += sampleWavetable(sawTable, voicePhase) / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length;
              });
            } else {
              SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
                const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
                const voiceFreq = oscFreq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);
                const voicePh = TWO_PI * voiceFreq * t;
                const voiceMH = Math.min(maxH(voiceFreq), 48);
                let voiceSample = 0;
                for (let h = 1; h <= voiceMH; h++) {
                  voiceSample += fastSin(voicePh * h) / h;
                }
                voiceSample *= 2 / Math.PI;
                sample += voiceSample / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length;
              });
            }
          } else {
            // Fallback for unknown waveforms
            let sg = 1;
            for (let h = 1; h <= mH; h += 2) {
              sample += sg * Math.cos(ph * h) / (h * h);
              sg = -sg;
            }
            sample *= 8 / (Math.PI * Math.PI);
          }

          b[i] += sample * env * os.level;
        }
      });

      const ab = c.createBuffer(1, n, sr);
      ab.copyToChannel(b, 0);
      releaseBuffer(b); // Return buffer to pool after copying to AudioBuffer
      const src = c.createBufferSource();
      const g = c.createGain();
      g.gain.value = 0.12;
      src.buffer = ab;
      src.connect(g);

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect to instrument's output
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        g.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(destination);

        // Apply filter envelope if enabled
        applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
      } else {
        g.connect(destination);
      }

      src.start();

    } else {
      // PolyBLEP synthesis (anti-aliased waveforms)
      const n = Math.floor(sr * dur);
      const b = acquireBuffer(n);

      // Pre-compute envelope curve once for all oscillators (major optimization)
      const envCurve = getEnvelopeCurve(dur, adsr, sr);

      // Generate and mix all active oscillators
      oscSet.forEach(os => {
        if (os.level <= 0) return;

        const oscFreq = f * Math.pow(2, os.oct) * Math.pow(2, os.detune / 1200);
        const dt = oscFreq / sr; // Phase increment for PolyBLEP

        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const t = i / sr;
          const ph = TWO_PI * oscFreq * t;
          const phase = (t * oscFreq) % 1; // Normalized phase [0, 1)
          // Use pre-computed envelope (array index instead of function call)
          const env = envCurve[i];
          let sample = 0;

          if (os.wave === 'sine') {
            sample = fastSin(ph);
          } else if (os.wave === 'square') {
            // PolyBLEP square wave
            sample = polyBlepSquare(phase, dt);
          } else if (os.wave === 'sawtooth') {
            // PolyBLEP sawtooth wave
            sample = polyBlepSaw(phase, dt);
          } else if (os.wave === 'triangle') {
            // PolyBLEP triangle wave
            sample = polyBlepTriangle(phase, dt);
          } else if (os.wave === 'pulse') {
            // PolyBLEP pulse wave with variable width
            const pw = os.pulseWidth / 100;
            sample = polyBlepPulse(phase, dt, pw);
          } else if (os.wave === 'supersaw') {
            // PolyBLEP super saw: 7 detuned sawtooth waves
            const spreadFactor = os.superSawSpread / 50;
            SUPERSAW_DETUNES.forEach(detuneCents => {
              const actualDetune = detuneCents * spreadFactor;
              const voiceFreq = oscFreq * Math.pow(2, actualDetune / 1200);
              const voiceDt = voiceFreq / sr;
              const voicePhase = (t * voiceFreq) % 1;
              const voiceSample = polyBlepSaw(voicePhase, voiceDt);
              sample += voiceSample / SUPERSAW_DETUNES.length;
            });
          } else {
            // Default to PolyBLEP triangle
            sample = polyBlepTriangle(phase, dt);
          }

          b[i] += sample * env * os.level;
        }
      });

      const ab = c.createBuffer(1, n, sr);
      ab.copyToChannel(b, 0);
      releaseBuffer(b); // Return buffer to pool after copying to AudioBuffer
      const src = c.createBufferSource();
      const g = c.createGain();
      g.gain.value = 0.12;
      src.buffer = ab;
      src.connect(g);

      // Apply key tracking to filter cutoff
      const keyTrackedFreq = calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, f, filterSettings.keyTrack);
      const adjustedFilterSettings = { ...filterSettings, frequency: keyTrackedFreq };

      // Create filter chain and connect to instrument's output
      const filterChain = createFilterChain(c, adjustedFilterSettings);
      if (filterChain) {
        g.connect(filterChain.input);
        filterChain.output.connect(destination);

        // Apply filter envelope if enabled
        applyFilterEnvelope(filterChain, f, adjustedFilterSettings, filterEnvSettings, c);
      } else {
        g.connect(destination);
      }

      src.start();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Save current UI control values to the specified instrument's settings cache
   * @param {number} instId - Instrument index (0-3)
   */
  function saveInstrumentSettings(instId) {
    if (instId < 0 || instId >= NUM_INSTRUMENTS) return;

    const inst = instruments[instId];
    const settings = inst.settings;

    // Save oscillator settings from UI
    for (let n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
      const inlineWave = document.querySelector('.osc-wave[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineOct = document.querySelector('.osc-oct[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineDetune = document.querySelector('.osc-detune[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineLevel = document.querySelector('.osc-level[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const modalPw = document.querySelector('.osc-pw-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const modalSpread = document.querySelector('.osc-spread-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');

      settings.osc[n - 1] = {
        wave: inlineWave ? inlineWave.value : 'sine',
        oct: inlineOct ? parseInt(inlineOct.value) || 0 : 0,
        detune: inlineDetune ? parseFloat(inlineDetune.value) || 0 : 0,
        level: inlineLevel ? parseFloat(inlineLevel.value) : 80,
        pulseWidth: modalPw ? parseFloat(modalPw.value) : 50,
        superSawSpread: modalSpread ? parseFloat(modalSpread.value) : 50
      };
    }

    // Save ADSR from UI
    settings.adsr = {
      a: parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrA')?.value) || 10,
      d: parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrD')?.value) || 100,
      s: parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrS')?.value) || 70,
      r: parseFloat(document.getElementById('adsrR')?.value) || 200
    };

    // Save filter settings from UI
    const filterEnabled = document.getElementById('filterEnabled');
    const filterType = document.getElementById('filterType');
    const filterFreq = document.getElementById('filterFreq');
    const filterQ = document.getElementById('filterQ');
    const filterKeyTrack = document.getElementById('filterKeyTrack');
    const filterModel = document.getElementById('filterModel');
    const filterSlopeRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="filterSlope"]:checked');

    settings.filter = {
      enabled: filterEnabled ? filterEnabled.checked : true,
      type: filterType ? filterType.value : 'lowpass',
      freq: filterFreq ? parseFloat(filterFreq.value) : 850,
      q: filterQ ? parseFloat(filterQ.value) : 10,
      keyTrack: filterKeyTrack ? parseFloat(filterKeyTrack.value) : 0,
      model: filterModel ? filterModel.value : 'butterworth',
      slope: filterSlopeRadio ? parseInt(filterSlopeRadio.value) : 24
    };

    // Save noise settings from UI
    const noiseType = document.getElementById('noiseType');
    const noiseLevel = document.getElementById('noiseLevel');

    settings.noise = {
      type: noiseType ? noiseType.value : 'white',
      level: noiseLevel ? parseFloat(noiseLevel.value) : 0
    };

    // Save filter envelope settings from UI
    const filterEnvEnabled = document.getElementById('filterEnvEnabled');
    const filterEnvAmount = document.getElementById('filterEnvAmount');
    const filterEnvA = document.getElementById('filterEnvA');
    const filterEnvD = document.getElementById('filterEnvD');
    const filterEnvS = document.getElementById('filterEnvS');
    const filterEnvR = document.getElementById('filterEnvR');
    const filterEnvLink = document.getElementById('filterEnvLinkToAmp');

    settings.filterEnv = {
      enabled: filterEnvEnabled ? filterEnvEnabled.checked : false,
      amount: filterEnvAmount ? parseFloat(filterEnvAmount.value) : 24,
      a: filterEnvA ? parseFloat(filterEnvA.value) : 200,
      d: filterEnvD ? parseFloat(filterEnvD.value) : 600,
      s: filterEnvS ? parseFloat(filterEnvS.value) : 0,
      r: filterEnvR ? parseFloat(filterEnvR.value) : 775,
      link: filterEnvLink ? filterEnvLink.checked : false
    };

    console.log('Saved settings for instrument', instId + 1, settings);
  }

  /**
   * Load the specified instrument's settings into the UI controls
   * @param {number} instId - Instrument index (0-3)
   */
  function loadInstrumentSettings(instId) {
    if (instId < 0 || instId >= NUM_INSTRUMENTS) return;

    const inst = instruments[instId];
    const settings = inst.settings;

    // Load oscillator settings to UI
    for (let n = 1; n <= 3; n++) {
      const osc = settings.osc[n - 1];

      // Inline controls
      const inlineWave = document.querySelector('.osc-wave[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineOct = document.querySelector('.osc-oct[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineDetune = document.querySelector('.osc-detune[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineDetuneVal = document.querySelector('.osc-detune-val[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineLevel = document.querySelector('.osc-level[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const inlineLevelVal = document.querySelector('.osc-level-val[data-osc="' + n + '"]');

      if (inlineWave) inlineWave.value = osc.wave;
      if (inlineOct) inlineOct.value = osc.oct;
      if (inlineDetune) inlineDetune.value = osc.detune;
      if (inlineDetuneVal) inlineDetuneVal.textContent = osc.detune;
      if (inlineLevel) inlineLevel.value = osc.level;
      if (inlineLevelVal) inlineLevelVal.textContent = osc.level;

      // Modal controls (pulse width, spread)
      const modalPw = document.querySelector('.osc-pw-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const modalPwVal = document.querySelector('.osc-pw-val-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const modalSpread = document.querySelector('.osc-spread-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');
      const modalSpreadVal = document.querySelector('.osc-spread-val-lg[data-osc="' + n + '"]');

      if (modalPw) modalPw.value = osc.pulseWidth;
      if (modalPwVal) modalPwVal.textContent = osc.pulseWidth + '%';
      if (modalSpread) modalSpread.value = osc.superSawSpread;
      if (modalSpreadVal) modalSpreadVal.textContent = osc.superSawSpread + '%';
    }

    // Load ADSR to UI
    const adsrA = document.getElementById('adsrA');
    const adsrD = document.getElementById('adsrD');
    const adsrS = document.getElementById('adsrS');
    const adsrR = document.getElementById('adsrR');
    const valA = document.getElementById('valA');
    const valD = document.getElementById('valD');
    const valS = document.getElementById('valS');
    const valR = document.getElementById('valR');

    if (adsrA) adsrA.value = settings.adsr.a;
    if (adsrD) adsrD.value = settings.adsr.d;
    if (adsrS) adsrS.value = settings.adsr.s;
    if (adsrR) adsrR.value = settings.adsr.r;
    // Update display values (using log scaling)
    if (valA) valA.textContent = sliderToTime(settings.adsr.a, 500, 500) + 'ms';
    if (valD) valD.textContent = sliderToTime(settings.adsr.d, 500, 500) + 'ms';
    if (valS) valS.textContent = settings.adsr.s + '%';
    if (valR) valR.textContent = sliderToTime(settings.adsr.r, 1000, 1000) + 'ms';

    // Load filter settings to UI
    const filterEnabled = document.getElementById('filterEnabled');
    const filterType = document.getElementById('filterType');
    const filterFreq = document.getElementById('filterFreq');
    const filterQ = document.getElementById('filterQ');
    const filterKeyTrack = document.getElementById('filterKeyTrack');
    const filterModel = document.getElementById('filterModel');
    const filterSlopeRadios = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="filterSlope"]');

    if (filterEnabled) filterEnabled.checked = settings.filter.enabled;
    if (filterType) filterType.value = settings.filter.type;
    if (filterFreq) filterFreq.value = settings.filter.freq;
    if (filterQ) filterQ.value = settings.filter.q;
    if (filterKeyTrack) filterKeyTrack.value = settings.filter.keyTrack;
    if (filterModel) filterModel.value = settings.filter.model;
    filterSlopeRadios.forEach(r => { r.checked = (parseInt(r.value) === settings.filter.slope); });

    // Load noise settings to UI
    const noiseType = document.getElementById('noiseType');
    const noiseLevel = document.getElementById('noiseLevel');

    if (noiseType) noiseType.value = settings.noise.type;
    if (noiseLevel) noiseLevel.value = settings.noise.level;

    // Load filter envelope settings to UI
    const filterEnvEnabled = document.getElementById('filterEnvEnabled');
    const filterEnvAmount = document.getElementById('filterEnvAmount');
    const filterEnvA = document.getElementById('filterEnvA');
    const filterEnvD = document.getElementById('filterEnvD');
    const filterEnvS = document.getElementById('filterEnvS');
    const filterEnvR = document.getElementById('filterEnvR');
    const filterEnvLink = document.getElementById('filterEnvLinkToAmp');

    if (filterEnvEnabled) filterEnvEnabled.checked = settings.filterEnv.enabled;
    if (filterEnvAmount) filterEnvAmount.value = settings.filterEnv.amount;
    if (filterEnvA) filterEnvA.value = settings.filterEnv.a;
    if (filterEnvD) filterEnvD.value = settings.filterEnv.d;
    if (filterEnvS) filterEnvS.value = settings.filterEnv.s;
    if (filterEnvR) filterEnvR.value = settings.filterEnv.r;
    if (filterEnvLink) filterEnvLink.checked = settings.filterEnv.link;

    console.log('Loaded settings for instrument', instId + 1);
  }

  /**
   * Switch to a different instrument
   * Saves current instrument settings and loads new instrument settings
   * @param {number} newInstId - New instrument index (0-3)
   */
  function setCurrentInstrument(newInstId) {
    if (newInstId < 0 || newInstId >= NUM_INSTRUMENTS) return;
    if (newInstId === currentInstrument) return;

    console.log('Switching from instrument', currentInstrument + 1, 'to', newInstId + 1);

    // Save current instrument's settings from UI
    saveInstrumentSettings(currentInstrument);

    // Update current instrument index
    const oldInstId = currentInstrument;
    currentInstrument = newInstId;

    // Update legacy masterOutput reference
    masterOutput = instruments[currentInstrument].masterOutput;

    // Reconnect worklet to the new instrument's master output (bus routing)
    if (synthWorkletNode) {
      try {
        synthWorkletNode.disconnect();
        const newDest = instruments[currentInstrument].masterOutput;
        if (newDest) {
          synthWorkletNode.connect(newDest);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Failed to reconnect worklet on instrument switch:', e);
      }
    }

    // Load new instrument's settings to UI
    loadInstrumentSettings(currentInstrument);

    // Restart continuous noise with new instrument's settings
    restartContinuousNoise();

    console.log('Switched to instrument', currentInstrument + 1);
  }

  /**
   * Get effect bus by index (0-3) or final bus (-1)
   * @param {number} index - Bus index (0=A, 1=B, 2=C, 3=D, -1=Final)
   * @returns {EffectChain|null} The effect chain for that bus
   */
  function getEffectBus(index) {
    if (index === -1) return finalBus;
    return effectBuses[index] || null;
  }

  /**
   * Set which bus an instrument routes to
   * @param {number} instIndex - Instrument index (0-3)
   * @param {number} busIndex - Bus index (0-3)
   */
  function setInstrumentBus(instIndex, busIndex) {
    if (instIndex < 0 || instIndex > 3) return;
    if (busIndex < 0 || busIndex > 3) return;

    const oldBus = instrumentBusAssignment[instIndex];
    if (oldBus === busIndex) return;

    const inst = instruments[instIndex];
    if (!inst || !inst.masterOutput) return;

    // Disconnect from old bus
    inst.masterOutput.disconnect();

    // Connect to new bus
    const newBus = effectBuses[busIndex];
    if (newBus) {
      inst.masterOutput.connect(newBus.input);
    } else {
      // Fallback to context destination
      const ctx = getCtx();
      inst.masterOutput.connect(ctx.destination);
    }

    instrumentBusAssignment[instIndex] = busIndex;
    console.log('Instrument', instIndex + 1, 'routed to Bus', ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'][busIndex]);
  }

  /**
   * Get current bus assignment for an instrument
   * @param {number} instIndex - Instrument index (0-3)
   * @returns {number} Bus index (0-3)
   */
  function getInstrumentBus(instIndex) {
    return instrumentBusAssignment[instIndex] || 0;
  }

  /**
   * Get all bus assignments
   * @returns {Array<number>} Array of bus indices for each instrument
   */
  function getAllBusAssignments() {
    return [...instrumentBusAssignment];
  }

  /**
   * Get the number of effect buses
   * @returns {number} Number of buses (4)
   */
  function getBusCount() {
    return 4;
  }

  /**
   * Get the final bus
   * @returns {EffectChain|null} The final bus effect chain
   */
  function getFinalBus() {
    return finalBus;
  }

  /**
   * Get all effect buses
   * @returns {Array<EffectChain>} Array of 4 effect bus chains
   */
  function getAllEffectBuses() {
    return effectBuses;
  }

  /**
   * Format ADSR time value for display (with logarithmic conversion)
   * @param {string} param - 'A', 'D', or 'R'
   * @param {number} sliderValue - Raw slider value
   * @returns {string} Formatted time value
   */
  function formatADSRTime(param, sliderValue) {
    if (!SL.audio || !SL.audio.sliderToTime) {
      return Math.round(sliderValue);  // Fallback to raw value
    }

    let timeMs;
    if (param === 'A' || param === 'D') {
      timeMs = SL.audio.sliderToTime(sliderValue, 500, 500);
    } else if (param === 'R') {
      timeMs = SL.audio.sliderToTime(sliderValue, 1000, 1000);
    } else {
      return Math.round(sliderValue);  // Sustain stays as-is
    }

    return Math.round(timeMs);
  }

  /**
   * Format filter envelope ADSR time value for display (with logarithmic conversion)
   * Filter envelope has larger ranges: A/D=0-2000ms, R=0-3000ms
   * @param {string} param - 'A', 'D', or 'R'
   * @param {number} sliderValue - Raw slider value
   * @returns {string} Formatted time value
   */
  function formatFilterEnvTime(param, sliderValue) {
    if (!SL.audio || !SL.audio.sliderToTime) {
      return Math.round(sliderValue);  // Fallback to raw value
    }

    let timeMs;
    if (param === 'A' || param === 'D') {
      timeMs = SL.audio.sliderToTime(sliderValue, 2000, 2000);
    } else if (param === 'R') {
      timeMs = SL.audio.sliderToTime(sliderValue, 3000, 3000);
    } else {
      return Math.round(sliderValue);  // Sustain stays as-is
    }

    return Math.round(timeMs);
  }

    setupOctaveControls();

    setupInstrumentSelector();

    // Initialize effect chain (requires audio context to be ready)
    // This will be called on first user interaction when audio context is created
    if (SL.audio && SL.audio.initEffectChain) {
      // Defer until audio context exists
      const originalGetCtx = SL.audio.getCtx;
      if (originalGetCtx) {
        const doInitEffects = function() {
          if (!SL.audio.effectChain) {
            SL.audio.initEffectChain();
            if (SL.effectsUI && SL.effectsUI.init) {
              SL.effectsUI.init();
            }
          }
        };
        const checkAndInitEffects = function() {
          const ctx = originalGetCtx();
          if (ctx && !SL.audio.effectChain) {
            if (ctx.state === 'running') {
              doInitEffects();
            } else {
              ctx.resume().then(function() {
                doInitEffects();
              });
            }
          }
        };
        // Do NOT create AudioContext eagerly - wait for user gesture
        // At high sample rates (192kHz), contexts created without user gesture
        // may not properly connect to audio output even after resume()
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', checkAndInitEffects, { once: true });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', checkAndInitEffects, { once: true });
      }
    }

    document.querySelector('.seq-wrapper').scrollTop = 216;

    noteReadout.textContent = 'Click a key to play';

   * Called when a note starts playing to show the actual filter cutoff being used
   * @param {number|null} noteFreq - Frequency of the note being played, or null to clear
   */
  function updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay(noteFreq) {
    const display = document.getElementById('filterKeyTrackedFreq-val-modal');
    if (!display) {
      console.log('KeyTrack display: element not found');
      return;
    }

    if (noteFreq === null) {
      // Don't clear immediately - leave last value or show base cutoff
      const filterSettings = SL.audio && SL.audio.getFilterSettings ? SL.audio.getFilterSettings() : null;
      if (filterSettings && filterSettings.keyTrack > 0) {
        // Show that it's waiting for a note
        display.textContent = '(play a note)';
      } else {
        // No key tracking, show same as cutoff
        if (filterSettings) {
          if (filterSettings.frequency >= 1000) {
            display.textContent = (filterSettings.frequency / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' kHz';
          } else {
            display.textContent = Math.round(filterSettings.frequency) + ' Hz';
          }
        } else {
          display.textContent = '--';
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    // Get current filter settings
    const filterSettings = SL.audio && SL.audio.getFilterSettings ? SL.audio.getFilterSettings() : null;
    if (!filterSettings) {
      console.log('KeyTrack display: no filter settings');
      display.textContent = '--';
      return;
    }

    console.log('KeyTrack display: noteFreq=' + noteFreq + ', baseFreq=' + filterSettings.frequency + ', keyTrack=' + filterSettings.keyTrack);

    // Calculate the key-tracked cutoff frequency
    const keyTrackedFreq = SL.audio && SL.audio.calcKeyTrackedFreq
      ? SL.audio.calcKeyTrackedFreq(filterSettings.frequency, noteFreq, filterSettings.keyTrack)
      : filterSettings.frequency;

    console.log('KeyTrack display: calculated freq=' + keyTrackedFreq);

    // Format the display
    if (keyTrackedFreq >= 1000) {
      display.textContent = (keyTrackedFreq / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' kHz';
    } else {
      display.textContent = Math.round(keyTrackedFreq) + ' Hz';
    }
  }

  // Export to SynthLab namespace
  SL.ui = {
    init: init,
    getBaseOctave: () => baseOctave,
    setBaseOctave: (v) => { baseOctave = v; },
    getCurrentNoteDisplay: () => currentNoteDisplay,
    setCurrentNoteDisplay: (v) => { currentNoteDisplay = v; },
    // DOM element getters for other modules
    getElements: () => ({

    }),
    rebuildAll: rebuildAll,
    updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay: updateKeyTrackedFreqDisplay
  };

  // Main entry point
  SL.init = init;
})();

// Synth Lab - Keyboard Module
(function() {
  const SL = window.SynthLab;

  // Local references to constants
  const NOTES = SL.NOTES;
  const DOT_CLASS = SL.DOT_CLASS;
  const OCT_CLASS = SL.OCT_CLASS;

  /**
   * Get the current scale notes based on root and mode selection
   * @returns {number[]} Array of pitch classes (0-11) in the current scale
   */
  function getScaleNotes() {
    const rootEl = document.getElementById('rootNote');
    const modeEl = document.getElementById('mode');
    const root = parseInt(rootEl.value);
    const m = SL.MODES[modeEl.value];
    return m.scale.map(s => (root + s) % 12);
  }

  /**
   * Update the octave range display
   */
  function updateOctRange() {
    const octRange = document.getElementById('octRange');
    const baseOct = SL.ui ? SL.ui.getBaseOctave() : 4;
    octRange.textContent = 'C' + baseOct + '-C' + (baseOct + 3);
  }

  /**
   * Convert MIDI note number to note name (e.g., 60 -> "C4")
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   * @returns {string} Note name with octave
   */
  function midiToName(midi) {
    const pc = midi % 12;
    const oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
    return NOTES[pc] + oct;
  }

  /**
   * Update the note readout display with the current note info
   * @param {number} midi - MIDI note number
   */
  function updateNoteReadout(midi) {
    const noteReadout = document.getElementById('noteReadout');
    const name = midiToName(midi);
    const freq = SL.audio.m2f(midi).toFixed(1);
    noteReadout.textContent = name + ' (' + freq + ' Hz)';
  }

  /**
   * Build the piano keyboard UI
   */
  function buildKeyboard() {
    const kbEl = document.getElementById('keyboard');
    kbEl.innerHTML = '';

    const scaleNotes = getScaleNotes();
    const baseOct = SL.ui ? SL.ui.getBaseOctave() : 4;
    const startMidi = (baseOct + 1) * 12;
    const endMidi = (baseOct + 4) * 12;

    for (let i = startMidi; i <= endMidi; i++) {
      const pc = i % 12;
      const oct = Math.floor(i / 12) - 1;
      const isBlack = [1, 3, 6, 8, 10].includes(pc);
      const inKey = scaleNotes.includes(pc);

      const key = document.createElement('div');
      key.className = 'key ' + (isBlack ? 'black' : 'white') + (inKey ? '' : ' out-key');
      key.dataset.note = i;

      // Create color dot for pitch class
      const dot = document.createElement('div');
      dot.className = 'note-dot ' + DOT_CLASS[pc];
      key.appendChild(dot);

      // Create octave stripe
      const stripe = document.createElement('div');
      stripe.className = 'oct-stripe ' + (OCT_CLASS[oct] || '');
      key.appendChild(stripe);

      // Create label
      const lbl = document.createElement('span');
      lbl.textContent = NOTES[pc] + oct;
      key.appendChild(lbl);

      // Event listeners for playing notes
      key.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
        e.preventDefault();
        SL.audio.startSustainedNote(i);
      });
      key.addEventListener('mouseup', () => SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(i));
      // Only stop on mouseleave if mouse button is NOT held down
      // This allows dragging to mixer modal while holding a note
      key.addEventListener('mouseleave', (e) => {
        if (e.buttons === 0) {
          SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(i);
        }
      });

      // Drag support for sequencer
      key.draggable = true;
      key.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
        const dragData = { midi: i, name: midiToName(i) };
        e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', JSON.stringify(dragData));
        SL.currentDragData = dragData;  // Store globally for dragover access
      });
      key.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
        SL.currentDragData = null;  // Clear global drag data
      });

      kbEl.appendChild(key);
    }

    updateOctRange();
  }

  // Export to SynthLab namespace
  SL.keyboard = {
    buildKeyboard,
    updateOctRange,
    getScaleNotes,
    midiToName,
    updateNoteReadout
  };
})();

// Synth Lab - Isomorphic Grid Module
(function() {
  const SL = window.SynthLab;

  // Local references to constants
  const NOTES = SL.NOTES;
  const BG_CLASS = SL.BG_CLASS;
  const OCT_CLASS = SL.OCT_CLASS;

  /**
   * Build the isomorphic keyboard grid
   * Supports multiple layouts: 4th, 5th, minor 3rd, and hexagonal
   */
  function buildIso() {
    const isoEl = document.getElementById('isoGrid');
    const isoLayoutEl = document.getElementById('isoLayout');
    const rootEl = document.getElementById('rootNote');

    isoEl.innerHTML = '';

    const scaleNotes = SL.keyboard.getScaleNotes();
    const root = parseInt(rootEl.value);
    const layout = isoLayoutEl.value;
    const isHex = layout === 'hex';

    const rows = 7;  // 3 octaves coverage
    const cols = 12;
    const interval = isHex ? 7 : parseInt(layout);

    for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'iso-row';

      // Offset odd rows for hex layout
      if (isHex && r % 2 === 1) {
        row.style.marginLeft = '10px';
      }

      // Calculate starting MIDI note for this row
      const baseOct = SL.ui ? SL.ui.getBaseOctave() : 4;
      const rowStart = (rows - 1 - r) * interval + (baseOct + 2) * 12;

      for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
        const midi = rowStart + c;
        const pc = midi % 12;
        const oct = Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1;
        const inKey = scaleNotes.includes(pc);
        const isRoot = pc === root;

        const key = document.createElement('div');
        key.className = 'iso-key ' + BG_CLASS[pc] +
          (inKey ? '' : ' out-key') +
          (isRoot ? ' root' : '') +
          (isHex ? ' hex' : '');
        key.dataset.midi = midi;
        key.innerHTML = NOTES[pc] + oct + '<span class="oct-dot ' + (OCT_CLASS[oct] || '') + '"></span>';

        // Event listeners for playing notes
        key.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
          e.preventDefault();
          SL.audio.startSustainedNote(midi);
        });
        key.addEventListener('mouseup', () => SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi));
        key.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => SL.audio.stopSustainedNote(midi));

        // Drag support for sequencer
        key.draggable = true;
        key.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
          const dragData = { midi, name: SL.keyboard.midiToName(midi) };
          e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', JSON.stringify(dragData));
          SL.currentDragData = dragData;  // Store globally for dragover access
        });
        key.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
          SL.currentDragData = null;  // Clear global drag data
        });

        row.appendChild(key);
      }

      isoEl.appendChild(row);
    }
  }

  // Export to SynthLab namespace
  SL.isomorphic = {
    buildIso
  };
})();

  // Section state for inversion and note count per chord section
  const sectionState = {
    prog: { inv: 0, notes: 3 },
    func: { inv: 0, notes: 3 },
    deg: { inv: 0, notes: 3 },
    pal: { inv: 0, notes: 3 }
  };

  // Get inversion setting for a section
  function getInv(sec) {
    if (sec && sectionState[sec]) return sectionState[sec].inv;
    return 0;
  }

  // Get note count setting for a section
  function getNoteCount(sec) {
    if (sec && sectionState[sec]) return sectionState[sec].notes;
    return 3;
  }

  // Get extended chord notes (up to 7 notes for 13th chords)
  function getExtendedNotes(baseMidi, type, count) {
    const base = SL.CHORD_INT[type] || [0, 4, 7];
    const extended = [0, 4, 7, 11, 14, 17, 21]; // root, 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th, 11th, 13th
    const notes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(count, 7); i++) {
      notes.push(baseMidi + (i < base.length ? base[i] : extended[i]));
    }
    return notes;
  }

  // Apply inversion to chord notes
  function applyInv(notes, inv) {
    const n = [...notes];
    for (let i = 0; i < inv && i < n.length - 1; i++) {
      n[i] += 12;
    }
    return n.sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }

  // Create a chord button
  function mkBtn(rootPc, type, label, oct, sec) {
    const name = SL.NOTES[rootPc] + SL.CHORD_NAME[type];
    const baseMidi = (oct || 4) * 12 + rootPc;
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'chord-btn ' + SL.CHORD_CLS[type];
    btn.textContent = label || name;

    let chordNotes = null;

    const getPlayNotes = () => {
      const cnt = getNoteCount(sec);
      const notes = getExtendedNotes(baseMidi, type, cnt);
      return applyInv(notes, getInv(sec));
    };

    btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', e => {
      const notes = getPlayNotes();
      const tt = document.getElementById('chordTooltip');
      if (tt) {
        tt.innerHTML = '<b>' + name + '</b>: ' + notes.map(SL.keyboard.midiToName).join(', ');
        tt.style.left = (e.clientX + 10) + 'px';
        tt.style.top = (e.clientY - 20) + 'px';
        tt.style.display = 'block';
      }
      const noteReadout = document.getElementById('noteReadout');
      if (noteReadout) {
        noteReadout.textContent = name + ': ' + notes.map(SL.keyboard.midiToName).join(', ');
      }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
      const tt = document.getElementById('chordTooltip');
      if (tt) {
        tt.style.left = (e.clientX + 10) + 'px';
        tt.style.top = (e.clientY - 20) + 'px';
      }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      const tt = document.getElementById('chordTooltip');
      if (tt) tt.style.display = 'none';
      if (!chordNotes) {
        const noteReadout = document.getElementById('noteReadout');
        if (noteReadout) noteReadout.textContent = 'Click a key to play';
      }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
      chordNotes = getPlayNotes();
      SL.audio.startSustainedChord(chordNotes, name, btn);
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseup', e => {
      if (chordNotes) {
        SL.audio.stopSustainedChord(chordNotes, btn);
        chordNotes = null;
      }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      if (chordNotes) {
        SL.audio.stopSustainedChord(chordNotes, btn);
        chordNotes = null;
      }
    });

    btn.draggable = true;
    btn.addEventListener('dragstart', e => {
      const playNotes = getPlayNotes();
      btn.classList.add('dragging');
      const dragData = { notes: playNotes, name };
      e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', JSON.stringify(dragData));
      SL.currentDragData = dragData;  // Store globally for dragover access
      if (chordNotes) {
        SL.audio.stopSustainedChord(chordNotes, btn);
        chordNotes = null;
      }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
      btn.classList.remove('dragging');
      SL.currentDragData = null;  // Clear global drag data
    });

    return btn;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Synthesized Drum Sound Generation (808/909 style)
  // ============================================================

  /**
   * Generate a complete 808-style drum kit
   */
  function generate808Kit(instId) {
    const ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      console.error('No audio context available');
      return;
    }

    const sampleRate = ctx.sampleRate;

    // Generate each drum sound
    const sounds = [
      { name: 'Kick', generator: generate808Kick },
      { name: 'Snare', generator: generate808Snare },
      { name: 'Closed HH', generator: generate808ClosedHat },
      { name: 'Open HH', generator: generate808OpenHat },
      { name: 'Clap', generator: generate808Clap },
      { name: 'Rim', generator: generate808Rim },
      { name: 'Low Tom', generator: () => generate808Tom(80) },
      { name: 'High Tom', generator: () => generate808Tom(120) },
      { name: 'Crash', generator: generate808Crash },
      { name: 'Ride', generator: generate808Ride },
      { name: 'Shaker', generator: generate808Shaker },
      { name: 'Conga', generator: generate808Conga },
      { name: 'Cowbell', generator: generate808Cowbell },
      { name: 'Claves', generator: generate808Claves },
      { name: 'Maracas', generator: generate808Maracas },
      { name: 'Lo Conga', generator: () => generate808Conga(150) }
    ];

    sounds.forEach((sound, padId) => {
      const buffer = sound.generator(ctx, sampleRate);
      if (buffer) {
        SL.sampler.assignSampleToPad(instId, padId, buffer, sound.name);
      }
    });

    // Refresh UI
    if (SL.samplerUI && SL.samplerUI.renderSamplerTab) {
      SL.samplerUI.renderSamplerTab();
    }

    console.log('Generated 808 kit for instrument', instId);
  }

  // --- Individual sound generators ---

  function generate808Kick(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.5;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // Pitch envelope: starts at ~150Hz, drops to ~50Hz
      const pitchEnv = 150 * Math.exp(-30 * t) + 50;
      const phase = 2 * Math.PI * pitchEnv * t;
      // Amplitude envelope
      const ampEnv = Math.exp(-4 * t);
      // Add slight click transient
      const click = t < 0.005 ? Math.exp(-t * 500) * 0.3 : 0;
      data[i] = (Math.sin(phase) * ampEnv + click) * 0.9;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Snare(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.3;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // Tone component (two frequencies)
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 180 * t) * Math.exp(-20 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 330 * t) * Math.exp(-25 * t);
      // Noise component
      const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-15 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.3 + tone2 * 0.2 + noise * 0.7) * 0.8;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808ClosedHat(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.08;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // Metallic tones
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 4000 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 6500 * t);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8300 * t);
      // Noise
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-60 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.2 + tone2 * 0.2 + tone3 * 0.1 + noise * 0.5) * env * 0.6;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808OpenHat(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.4;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 4000 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 6500 * t);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8300 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-8 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.2 + tone2 * 0.2 + tone3 * 0.1 + noise * 0.5) * env * 0.6;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Clap(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.3;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // Multiple short bursts for clap texture
      let env = 0;
      if (t < 0.01) env = 1;
      else if (t < 0.02) env = 0.5;
      else if (t < 0.03) env = 0.7;
      else if (t < 0.04) env = 0.3;
      else env = Math.exp(-20 * (t - 0.04));
      // Bandpass filtered noise
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      data[i] = noise * env * 0.8;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Rim(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.05;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1700 * t);
      const env = Math.exp(-100 * t);
      data[i] = tone * env * 0.9;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Tom(baseFreq = 100) {
    return function(ctx, sampleRate) {
      const duration = 0.4;
      const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
      const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
      const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

      for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        const t = i / sampleRate;
        const pitchEnv = baseFreq * (1 + 2 * Math.exp(-30 * t));
        const phase = 2 * Math.PI * pitchEnv * t;
        const ampEnv = Math.exp(-8 * t);
        data[i] = Math.sin(phase) * ampEnv * 0.8;
      }
      return buffer;
    };
  }

  function generate808Crash(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 1.5;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 3500 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5200 * t * 1.02);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7300 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-3 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.15 + tone2 * 0.15 + tone3 * 0.1 + noise * 0.6) * env * 0.5;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Ride(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 1.0;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 4500 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 6000 * t);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7500 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-4 * t);
      const attack = t < 0.002 ? t / 0.002 : 1;
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.25 + tone2 * 0.2 + tone3 * 0.15 + noise * 0.4) * env * attack * 0.5;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Shaker(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.15;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.sin(Math.PI * t / duration) * Math.exp(-10 * t);
      data[i] = noise * env * 0.4;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Conga(baseFreq = 200) {
    return function(ctx, sampleRate) {
      const duration = 0.25;
      const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
      const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
      const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

      for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        const t = i / sampleRate;
        const pitchEnv = baseFreq * (1 + 0.5 * Math.exp(-50 * t));
        const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * pitchEnv * t);
        const env = Math.exp(-15 * t);
        data[i] = tone * env * 0.7;
      }
      return buffer;
    };
  }

  function generate808Cowbell(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.3;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 562 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 845 * t);
      const env = Math.exp(-10 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.6 + tone2 * 0.4) * env * 0.6;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Claves(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.1;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 2500 * t);
      const env = Math.exp(-50 * t);
      data[i] = tone * env * 0.7;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate808Maracas(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.08;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-80 * t);
      data[i] = noise * env * 0.4;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  // Place a drum pattern on the sequencer (repeats across all 4 bars)
  function placeDrumPattern(pattern, instId) {
    if (!SL.sequencer || !SL.sequencer.seqNotes) return;

    const seqNotes = SL.sequencer.seqNotes;
    const barsToFill = 4;
    const stepsPerBar = 16;

    // Repeat pattern across all 4 bars
    for (let bar = 0; bar < barsToFill; bar++) {
      const barOffset = bar * stepsPerBar;

      pattern.pattern.forEach(track => {
        track.steps.forEach(step => {
          seqNotes.push({
            row: track.pad,
            start: barOffset + step,
            dur: 2,  // 8th note duration
            midi: SL.SEQ_BASE_MIDI + track.pad,
            instrument: instId
          });
        });
      });
    }

    if (SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes) {
      SL.sequencer.renderSeqNotes();
    }
  }

      const getProgChords = () => {
        const seqChords = [];
        prog.degs.forEach(d => {
          if (m.scale.length > d) {
            const pc = (root + m.scale[d % m.scale.length]) % 12;
            const type = m.triads[d % m.triads.length];
            const baseMidi = chordOct * 12 + pc;

          }
        });

      placeBtn.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => {

        usageEl.textContent = prog.usage;
        labelCol.appendChild(usageEl);
      }
      grp.appendChild(labelCol);

      // Chord items with degree labels above each chord
      const chords = document.createElement('div');
      chords.className = 'prog-chords';
      prog.degs.forEach(d => {
        if (m.scale.length > d) {
          const pc = (root + m.scale[d % m.scale.length]) % 12;
          const type = m.triads[d % m.triads.length];

          const item = document.createElement('div');
          item.className = 'prog-chord-item';

          const num = type === 'maj' ? SL.NUMS[d] : SL.NUMS[d].toLowerCase();

  SL.chords = {

  };

  /**
   * Generate a 909-style drum kit (brighter, punchier than 808)
   */
  function generate909Kit(instId) {
    const ctx = SL.audio.getCtx();
    if (!ctx) {
      console.error('No audio context available');
      return;
    }

    const sampleRate = ctx.sampleRate;

    // 909 sounds are generally punchier and brighter than 808
    const sounds = [
      { name: 'Kick', generator: generate909Kick },
      { name: 'Snare', generator: generate909Snare },
      { name: 'Closed HH', generator: generate909ClosedHat },
      { name: 'Open HH', generator: generate909OpenHat },
      { name: 'Clap', generator: generate909Clap },
      { name: 'Rim', generator: generate909Rim },
      { name: 'Low Tom', generator: () => generate909Tom(ctx, sampleRate, 100) },
      { name: 'Mid Tom', generator: () => generate909Tom(ctx, sampleRate, 150) },
      { name: 'High Tom', generator: () => generate909Tom(ctx, sampleRate, 200) },
      { name: 'Crash', generator: generate909Crash },
      { name: 'Ride', generator: generate909Ride },
      { name: 'Shaker', generator: generate808Shaker },
      { name: 'Conga', generator: generate808Conga },
      { name: 'Cowbell', generator: generate808Cowbell },
      { name: 'Claves', generator: generate808Claves },
      { name: 'Maracas', generator: generate808Maracas }
    ];

    sounds.forEach((sound, padId) => {
      const buffer = sound.generator(ctx, sampleRate);
      if (buffer) {
        SL.sampler.assignSampleToPad(instId, padId, buffer, sound.name);
      }
    });

    // Refresh UI
    if (SL.samplerUI && SL.samplerUI.renderSamplerTab) {
      SL.samplerUI.renderSamplerTab();
    }

    console.log('Generated 909 kit for instrument', instId);
  }

  // 909-style generators (punchier, more attack)
  function generate909Kick(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.4;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // 909 kick has sharper pitch drop
      const pitchEnv = 200 * Math.exp(-50 * t) + 55;
      const phase = 2 * Math.PI * pitchEnv * t;
      const ampEnv = Math.exp(-6 * t);
      // Stronger click for punch
      const click = t < 0.003 ? Math.exp(-t * 800) * 0.5 : 0;
      data[i] = (Math.sin(phase) * ampEnv + click) * 0.95;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909Snare(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.25;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // 909 snare has more body tones
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 200 * t) * Math.exp(-30 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 420 * t) * Math.exp(-35 * t);
      // Brighter noise
      const noise = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-20 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.4 + tone2 * 0.3 + noise * 0.6) * 0.85;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909ClosedHat(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.06;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // Higher frequencies for 909
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5500 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8000 * t);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 10500 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-80 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.15 + tone2 * 0.15 + tone3 * 0.1 + noise * 0.6) * env * 0.7;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909OpenHat(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.5;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5500 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8000 * t);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 10500 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-6 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.15 + tone2 * 0.15 + tone3 * 0.1 + noise * 0.6) * env * 0.6;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909Clap(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.35;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      // More defined bursts
      let env = 0;
      if (t < 0.008) env = 1;
      else if (t < 0.016) env = 0.4;
      else if (t < 0.024) env = 0.8;
      else if (t < 0.032) env = 0.2;
      else env = Math.exp(-15 * (t - 0.032));
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      // Add some tone
      const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1200 * t) * 0.2;
      data[i] = (noise + tone) * env * 0.75;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909Rim(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 0.04;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 2200 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 3500 * t) * 0.5;
      const env = Math.exp(-150 * t);
      data[i] = (tone + tone2) * env * 0.85;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909Tom(ctx, sampleRate, baseFreq) {
    const duration = 0.35;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const pitchEnv = baseFreq * (1 + 1.5 * Math.exp(-40 * t));
      const phase = 2 * Math.PI * pitchEnv * t;
      const ampEnv = Math.exp(-10 * t);
      data[i] = Math.sin(phase) * ampEnv * 0.85;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909Crash(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 1.8;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 4000 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5800 * t * 1.01);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8000 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-2.5 * t);
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.12 + tone2 * 0.12 + tone3 * 0.08 + noise * 0.68) * env * 0.55;
    }
    return buffer;
  }

  function generate909Ride(ctx, sampleRate) {
    const duration = 1.2;
    const length = Math.floor(sampleRate * duration);
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);

    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const t = i / sampleRate;
      const tone1 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5000 * t);
      const tone2 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 6800 * t);
      const tone3 = Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 8200 * t);
      const noise = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
      const env = Math.exp(-3 * t);
      const attack = t < 0.001 ? t / 0.001 : 1;
      data[i] = (tone1 * 0.3 + tone2 * 0.25 + tone3 * 0.15 + noise * 0.3) * env * attack * 0.55;
    }
    return buffer;
  }
})();
